entries.v: 一种生活在约3.4亿年前早石炭世的海百合，属于在浅海海底形成大片“草甸”的海百合类，它们的骨骼后来堆积成了英格兰的石炭纪石灰岩。它光滑的碗状萼部高高地长在一根略微扭转的长茎上，展开五条分枝的羽状腕，从水流中捕捉食物颗粒。和其他海百合一样，它能再生失去的腕，因此受伤后恢复很快。

entries.k: A sea lily of the Early Jurassic, about 195 million years old, that lived not on the seabed but hanging from floating driftwood in the open sea. Long, five-sided stems ringed with tendrils held crowns of densely branched, feathery arms that strained plankton from the water. At Lyme Regis in Dorset whole masses of them are preserved tangled around fossil logs. When the waterlogged wood finally sank, the colony died with it.
entries.v: 一种早侏罗世的海百合，距今约1.95亿年，它并不生活在海底，而是悬挂在开阔海面上漂浮的浮木上。长长的五棱形茎上环生着卷枝，顶端的冠部由密集分枝的羽状腕组成，用来从水中滤取浮游生物。在多塞特郡的莱姆里吉斯，成团的个体缠绕在化石原木上被保存下来。当浸透水的木头最终沉没时，整个群体也随之死去。

entries.k: A sea scorpion about 45 cm long from the Late Ordovician of New York State, a close relative of Megalograptus. Its name means 'spiny jaw': its front limbs bristled with long, sharp, paired spines for seizing prey and holding it to the mouth. Heavily armed and quick to strike, it was one of the most dangerous hunters of its sea floor, though its thin armour left it vulnerable.
entries.v: 一种体长约45厘米的海蝎（板足鲎），生活在美国纽约州的奥陶纪晚期，是巨刻鲎的近亲。它的名字意为“多刺的颚”：前肢上密布成对的长而尖锐的刺，用来抓住猎物并送到嘴边。它武装精良、出击迅速，是当时海底最危险的猎手之一，不过外壳较薄，容易受伤。

entries.k: A sea scorpion about 54 cm long from freshwater rocks of Argentina about 300 million years old, at the very end of the Carboniferous. When it was described in 1980 it was taken for the largest spider that ever lived, but better fossils showed in 2005 that it was a mycteroptid eurypterid. It had a broad, rounded head shield and a wide body, and probably raked through the mud with the spiny front legs, sweeping up small animals.
entries.v: 一种长约54厘米的海蝎，来自阿根廷约3亿年前、石炭纪最末期的淡水岩层。1980年命名时，它被当作有史以来最大的蜘蛛，但2005年更好的化石表明它是一种属于Mycteroptidae科的板足鲎。它有宽阔圆润的头甲和宽大的身体，可能用多刺的前肢耙梳泥层，扫取小动物。

entries.k: A sea scorpion about 75 cm long from the Late Silurian of Ringerike, Norway, about 420 million years ago. Its first two pairs of walking legs were long and armed with long paired spines, forming a basket to trap prey. It may have carried its narrow, spike-tipped tail arched over its back like a scorpion. It lived in shallow coastal and brackish water.
entries.v: 一种来自挪威林厄里克晚志留世的海蝎，体长约75厘米，生活在约4.2亿年前。它的前两对步足很长，长着成对的长刺，形成捕捉猎物的篮子。它可能像蝎子一样把细长、末端带尖刺的尾巴弓起举在背上。它生活在浅海沿岸和半咸水中。

entries.k: A sea scorpion about 90 cm long from the Late Silurian of Indiana, with a broad, flattened, almost round body and a narrow, rounded tail ending in a long spike. Its strong front legs pointed forward and bristled with long, curved spines, forming a cage to trap prey. It was probably a slow ambush hunter that waited on the sea floor and snatched animals that came too close.
entries.v: 一种体长约90厘米的海蝎，生活于美国印第安纳州的晚志留世，身体宽阔扁平、近乎圆形，窄而圆的尾部末端是一根长刺。它强壮的前足向前伸出，长满长而弯曲的刺，组成一个困住猎物的笼子。它可能是一种行动缓慢的伏击猎手，守在海底，捕捉靠得太近的动物。

entries.k: A sea scorpion from the Late Ordovician (Katian) of southwestern Ohio, about 450 million years ago, roughly 50-80 cm long. Its front legs were long and armed with pairs of very long, movable spines, forming a cage for trapping prey, while its hind legs were broad swimming paddles. Its tail ended in a spine flanked by a pair of serrated blades, which it may have used as a weapon or to steer.
entries.v: 一种来自俄亥俄州西南部晚奥陶世（凯迪期）的海蝎，生活在约4.5亿年前，体长约50至80厘米。它的前足很长，长着成对的很长的可动刺，构成捕捉猎物的笼子，而后足则是宽阔的游泳桨。它的尾部末端是一根尖刺，两侧各有一片锯齿状的刃片，可能用作武器或用来掌控方向。

entries.k: A sea snail a few centimetres across from mid-Silurian reefs of Dudley in England and Gotland in Sweden. Its thick, low, almost disc-shaped shell had angular whorls with a strong, knobbly keel around the shoulder and a wide opening underneath. It crept slowly over the reef grazing on microbial films and debris, and could withdraw into its heavy shell, which few predators could crack.
entries.v: 一种几厘米宽的海螺，生活于英国达德利和瑞典哥得兰岛志留纪中期的礁中。它厚实低矮、近乎圆盘状的壳有棱角分明的螺层，肩部环绕一道粗壮多瘤的龙骨，底部开口宽阔。它在礁上缓慢爬行，刮食微生物膜和碎屑，能缩进沉重的壳里，很少有掠食者能把它咬碎。

entries.k: A second infection is beaten faster than the first.
entries.v: 第二次感染比第一次更快被击退。

entries.k: A semi-aquatic docodont, a close relative of true mammals, from Middle Jurassic lake deposits about 164 million years old in Inner Mongolia. About 45 cm long, it had dense fur, webbed, sprawling limbs for swimming and digging, and a broad, flat, scaly tail like a beaver's. Its recurved, seal-like teeth were suited to gripping fish and aquatic invertebrates. It showed that mammal relatives had taken to the water far earlier than once thought.
entries.v: 一种半水生的柱齿兽类，是真正哺乳动物的近亲，产自内蒙古约1.64亿年前的中侏罗世湖相沉积。它体长约45厘米，有浓密的毛发、有蹼且向两侧伸展的四肢，可用于游泳和挖掘，还有一条像河狸那样宽而扁平、覆有鳞片的尾巴。它后弯的、类似海豹的牙齿适合咬住鱼类和水生无脊椎动物。它表明哺乳动物的近亲进入水中的时间远比过去认为的要早。

entries.k: A shapeless single cell that crawls by flowing into finger-like pseudopods and engulfs bacteria, algae and smaller protists whole. Soft-bodied amoebae leave almost no fossil record, so it stands in for the ancient protists of every age.
entries.v: 一种没有固定形状的单细胞生物，靠细胞质流入指状伪足来爬行，将细菌、藻类和更小的原生生物整个吞下。柔软的变形虫几乎不留下化石记录，因此它在此代表各个时代的古老原生生物。

entries.k: A shark up to about a metre long from the Early Carboniferous seas of North America, about 340 million years ago. Males carried a strange 'ironing board' on the back: a tall spine topped by a broad, flat brush covered, like the top of the head, with enlarged tooth-like denticles. It was a quick, agile hunter of fish and squid-like animals, and the brush may have been used for display or to look too big to swallow.
entries.v: 一种体长可达约1米的鲨鱼，生活在约3.4亿年前北美的早石炭世海洋中。雄性背上长着一块奇特的“熨衣板”：一根高高的棘刺顶着宽而平的刷状结构，它和头顶一样覆盖着增大的齿状鳞片。它是一种敏捷迅速的猎手，捕食鱼类和类似乌贼的动物；那块刷状结构可能用于炫耀，或让自己看起来大得无法被吞下。

entries.k: A sheep-sized horned-dinosaur relative about 1.8 metres long from the Gobi Desert of Mongolia, about 75-71 million years ago. It had a large head with a deep beak and a broad bony frill over the neck, but no true horns. Its fossils are so common that whole growth series from hatchlings to adults are known, and one is locked in a fight with a Velociraptor. It has been suggested, though it is disputed, that its beaked skulls inspired the legend of the griffin.
entries.v: 一种绵羊大小、角龙类的近亲，体长约1.8米，来自蒙古戈壁沙漠，距今约7500万-7100万年。它有一个长着深喙的大脑袋和覆盖颈部的宽阔骨质颈盾，但没有真正的角。它的化石非常常见，从幼崽到成体的完整生长序列都已为人所知，其中一件还与伶盗龙扭打在一起。有人提出它带喙的头骨启发了狮鹫传说，但这一说法尚有争议。
短暂而激烈的交配季节。

entries.k: A short-necked polycotylid plesiosaur about 4.5 metres long from the inland sea of North America about 80 million years ago. Its long, slender jaws were lined with needle-like teeth for snapping up fast fish and squid, and its streamlined body and four long flippers made it one of the fastest swimmers of its time. Like its close relatives it gave birth to a single large live baby at sea instead of laying eggs.
entries.v: 一种短颈的多板龙科蛇颈龙，体长约4.5米，约8000万年前生活在北美内陆海。它细长的颌部长满针状牙齿，用来捕捉敏捷的鱼和鱿鱼，流线型的身体和四只长鳍使它成为当时最快的游泳者之一。和近亲一样，它在海中直接产下一只大幼崽，而不是产卵。

entries.k: A shrew-sized mammal, weighing perhaps 15 grams, from rocks about 160 million years old in Liaoning, north-eastern China. Described in 2011 from a nearly complete skeleton, it was proposed as the earliest known eutherian, the lineage that leads to placental mammals, which would put their split from the marsupial line in the Jurassic. Its sharp teeth suggest it ate insects, and its hand bones point to an agile climber.
entries.v: 一种鼩鼱大小的哺乳动物，体重约15克，出自中国东北辽宁约1.6亿年前的岩层。2011年根据一具近乎完整的骨骼描述，被认为是已知最早的真兽类——通向胎盘哺乳动物的支系，这意味着它们与有袋类支系的分化发生在侏罗纪。它锋利的牙齿表明其以昆虫为食，手骨则显示它是敏捷的攀爬者。

entries.k: A shrimp-like Burgess Shale arthropod up to about 8 cm long, with a two-valved carapace over its front half, stalked eyes, long antennae and a slender segmented abdomen ending in two paddle-like tail flaps. Some females carry clusters of eggs under the carapace, the oldest direct evidence of brood care in the fossil record. It probably swam and hunted small soft-bodied prey near the seafloor; it is named after Mount Wapta near the quarry.
entries.v: 一种外形似虾的布尔吉斯页岩节肢动物，体长可达约8厘米，身体前半部覆盖着双瓣背甲，具有带柄的眼、长长的触角，以及纤细分节、末端有两片桨状尾叶的腹部。一些雌性在背甲下携带成团的卵，这是化石记录中最古老的育幼直接证据。它可能在海底附近游泳并捕食小型软体猎物；其名称来自化石采石场附近的瓦普塔山。

entries.k: A shrimp-like crustacean up to about 20 cm long including its tail, from the Silurian of Scotland. A smooth, two-sided shell covered its head and front body, and a long, muscular abdomen ended in a dagger-like spine flanked by two shorter ones. By flicking this three-pronged tail it could shoot away from danger very fast; it probably fed on dead and small animals on the sea floor.
entries.v: 一种像虾的甲壳动物，连尾巴在内体长可达约20厘米，生活于苏格兰的志留纪。光滑的双瓣壳覆盖着它的头部和身体前部，长而有力的腹部末端是一根匕首状的刺，两侧各有一根较短的刺。它甩动这条三叉尾巴就能极快地逃离危险；它可能以海底的死亡动物和小动物为食。

entries.k: A single-celled freshwater predator about 50 micrometres across: a foamy, vacuolated sphere bristling with stiff radiating axopodia that snare passing flagellates and ciliates. Heliozoans leave no fossils, so it stands in for the ancient protist plankton that every later food web rests on.
entries.v: 一种直径约50微米的单细胞淡水捕食者：一个泡沫状、充满液泡的球体，四周放射出坚硬的轴伪足，捕捉经过的鞭毛虫和纤毛虫。太阳虫不留下化石，因此它在此代表古老的原生浮游生物——此后一切食物网的基础。

entries.k: A sleek lobe-finned hunter about 1.6 metres long from the Late Devonian rivers of New South Wales, Australia, about 365 million years ago. Torpedo-shaped, with its dorsal and anal fins set far back and a symmetrical tail, it was built for sudden bursts of speed like a modern pike or barracuda. It waited in ambush and shot forward to seize armoured fish in its long, fanged jaws, but its lightly built body could not take much punishment.
entries.v: 一种体态修长的肉鳍鱼类猎手，体长约1.6米，来自约3.65亿年前澳大利亚新南威尔士州的晚泥盆世河流。它身体呈鱼雷形，背鳍和臀鳍位置靠后，尾鳍对称，像现代的狗鱼或梭鱼一样专为瞬间爆发而生。它埋伏等待，然后猛冲而出，用布满獠牙的长颌咬住披甲的鱼，但它轻巧的身体经不起太多打击。

entries.k: A slender Burgess Shale arthropod about 5 cm long, with a downturned snout and a pair of great appendages under its head, each branching into three long, whip-like flagella. It probably used them to feel for and grab small prey as it swam or walked over the mud. It belongs to the megacheirans, early great-appendage arthropods that may be related to the ancestors of spiders and their kin.
entries.v: 一种来自伯吉斯页岩的细长节肢动物，长约5厘米，吻部向下弯曲，头部下方有一对大附肢，每个附肢都分出三根长长的鞭状鞭毛。它可能在游泳或在泥面上行走时，用这些附肢探寻并抓取小型猎物。它属于巨螯类，即早期的大附肢节肢动物，可能与蜘蛛及其近亲的祖先有亲缘关系。

entries.k: A slender early theropod dinosaur about 3 metres long but weighing only around 20 kg, from the Late Triassic of the south-western United States about 212 million years ago. It had a long, narrow head with many small serrated teeth, a long S-shaped neck, grasping hands and long bird-like legs. Hundreds of skeletons were found together in the Ghost Ranch quarry of New Mexico, and it is New Mexico's state fossil; a Coelophysis skull was even taken to the space station Mir in 1998.
entries.v: 一种体态纤细的早期兽脚类恐龙，体长约3米，但体重仅约20公斤，来自美国西南部的晚三叠世，距今约2.12亿年。它有狭长的头部，长满许多带锯齿的小牙，S形的长颈、可抓握的手和像鸟一样的长腿。在新墨西哥州的幽灵牧场采石场中曾一起发现数百具骨架，它也是新墨西哥州的州化石；1998年甚至有一具腔骨龙头骨被带上了和平号空间站。

entries.k: A slender sea scorpion about 70 cm long from the Silurian of Scotland, a lighter relative of Pterygotus. It had long, thin pincers with small curved teeth, big eyes, broad swimming paddles and a wide, flat tail fin split into two lobes at its tip. Built for speed rather than strength, it chased small fish through open water but had only a thin shell.
entries.v: 一种体长约70厘米的修长海蝎，生活于苏格兰的志留纪，是翼肢鲎较轻巧的近亲。它有细长的螯肢和弯曲的小齿、大眼睛、宽阔的游泳桨，以及末端分成两叶的宽而扁平的尾鳍。它为速度而生而非力量，在开阔水域中追逐小鱼，但外壳很薄。

entries.k: A slender straight-shelled nautiloid of the Middle Ordovician seas of Baltica, its tapering conch up to about 20 cm long, finely ringed with growth lines and divided inside into gas-filled chambers threaded by a narrow siphuncle. It hovered horizontally and hunted small prey with its arms. Its fossils, packed by the thousand into the Orthoceras limestone of Sweden and the Baltic, are among the most familiar of all cephalopod fossils.
entries.v: 一种生活在中奥陶世波罗的古陆海域的细长直壳鹦鹉螺，渐尖的壳长约20厘米，表面有细密的生长环纹，内部分隔成充气的气室，由一条细窄的体管贯穿。它水平悬浮，用腕捕捉小型猎物。它的化石成千上万地密集保存在瑞典和波罗的海地区的直角石灰岩中，是最为人熟知的头足类化石之一。

entries.k: A slender tree frog of Central American rainforests that sleeps by day pressed flat against a leaf, its blue-and-cream flanks and orange feet tucked away so it looks all green. Disturbed, it flashes its huge scarlet eyes and bright colours to startle a predator, and sticky toe pads let it cling to the undersides of leaves. Eggs are laid on leaves over ponds, and the embryos can hatch early and drop into the water when a snake or wasp attacks the clutch.
entries.v: 一种生活在中美洲雨林中的纤细树蛙，白天紧贴叶片睡觉，把蓝色与乳白色的体侧和橙色的脚收起，看上去通体翠绿。受到惊扰时，它会亮出巨大的猩红色眼睛和鲜艳的体色来惊吓捕食者，黏性趾垫让它能倒挂在叶片背面。卵产在池塘上方的叶片上，当蛇或胡蜂袭击卵团时，胚胎能提前孵化并掉入水中。

entries.k: A slender, corkscrewing flagellate that lives in the blood of African mammals and is carried from one to the next by the bite of tsetse flies. It swims with a flagellum running along a frilly undulating membrane, and escapes the host's immune defences by changing its coat of surface proteins again and again. In people and cattle it causes sleeping sickness and nagana; wild antelopes and other game mostly carry it unharmed.
entries.v: 一种细长的鞭毛虫，像开瓶器一样螺旋扭动着前进，生活在非洲哺乳动物的血液中，通过采采蝇的叮咬从一个宿主传到下一个宿主。它靠一根沿着褶边状波动膜延伸的鞭毛游动，并一次又一次地更换表面蛋白质外衣来逃避宿主的免疫防御。在人和牛身上，它会引起昏睡病和那加那病；而野生羚羊等野生动物大多携带它却安然无恙。

entries.k: A slender, eel-like jawless fish about 17 cm long from the early Silurian of Lesmahagow, Scotland, about 430 million years ago. Its body was soft and only lightly scaled, with a long fin fold along each side, a round mouth, large eyes and a row of gill openings. It may be a relative of the anaspids or of the lampreys, and it probably sucked up small food from the water or the sea floor.
entries.v: 一种细长如鳗的无颌鱼，体长约17厘米，来自苏格兰莱斯马黑戈的早志留世地层，距今约4.3亿年。它的身体柔软，鳞片很少，两侧各有一条长长的鳍褶，口呈圆形，眼睛很大，还有一排鳃孔。它可能是缺甲鱼类或七鳃鳗的亲属，很可能从水中或海底吸食小型食物。

entries.k: A slender, elongate fusulinid a few millimetres long from the Early Permian of the Glass Mountains of West Texas, about 285 million years ago, named in honour of the German geologist Carl Wilhelm von Gümbel. Its spindle-shaped test is narrower than those of its relatives, with finely fluted septa. Common in early Leonardian beds, it helps date Permian rocks; today it is often placed in the genus Praeskinnerella.
entries.v: 一种细长的蜓类，长数毫米，出自得克萨斯州西部格拉斯山脉约2.85亿年前的早二叠世地层，为纪念德国地质学家卡尔·威廉·冯·居姆贝尔而命名。它的纺锤形壳比近亲更窄，隔壁具细密褶皱。它常见于伦纳德期早期地层，有助于确定二叠纪岩层的年代；如今它常被归入 Praeskinnerella 属。

entries.k: A slender, fast-running ornithopod about 3 metres long from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation of the western United States. Its long, powerful hind legs, with very long shins, made it one of the fastest dinosaurs of its time, and it relied on speed rather than armour to escape predators such as Allosaurus. It cropped plants with a horny beak and ground them with ridged cheek teeth.
entries.v: 一种身体修长、善于奔跑的鸟脚类恐龙，体长约3米，生活在美国西部晚侏罗世的莫里森组。它强壮的长后肢配有很长的小腿，使它成为当时跑得最快的恐龙之一，它依靠速度而非装甲来躲避异特龙等掠食者。它用角质喙切取植物，再用有棱的颊齿磨碎。

entries.k: A slender, four-sided tube a few centimetres long, built of overlapping rings of small hardened plates, from the last Ediacaran seas of Brazil, Paraguay and the western United States. The polyp inside, probably an early relative of jellyfish, reached out of the open top to catch food and drew back in when threatened. Its jointed armour is among the oldest animal skeletons, making it very hard to crack, though it has little to fight back with.
entries.v: 一种细长的四棱管状动物，长几厘米，由一圈圈相互叠覆的小硬片构成，发现于巴西、巴拉圭和美国西部的埃迪卡拉纪末期海洋沉积中。管内的水螅体可能是水母的早期亲戚，会从开口处伸出捕食，受威胁时缩回。它分节的铠甲是最古老的动物骨骼之一，很难被攻破，不过它几乎没有还手之力。

entries.k: A slender, jawless anaspid fish about 12 cm long from the Late Silurian of Ringerike, Norway. Its torpedo-shaped body was covered in narrow scales, with a long row of small gill openings behind each eye, a crest of hooked scales along the back, long fin folds along the belly and a large, down-turned tail. A fast, agile swimmer, it fed on small particles in the water and on the bottom.
entries.v: 一种修长的无颌缺甲鱼，体长约12厘米，生活于挪威林厄里克的晚志留世。它鱼雷形的身体覆盖着窄长的鳞片，每只眼睛后方有一长排小鳃孔，背上有一列钩状鳞片，腹部有长长的鳍褶，尾巴大而下弯。它是敏捷快速的游泳者，以水中和海底的细小颗粒为食。

entries.k: A slender, long-legged plant-eater about 2.3 metres long from the Late Triassic of Poland, about 230 million years ago, a close relative of the first dinosaurs and perhaps an early bird-hipped dinosaur. It walked on four long, thin legs and had a small head on a long neck, with a toothless, beak-like tip to its lower jaw. It probably ate plants and beetles, and escaped danger by running.
entries.v: 一种身形纤细、四肢修长的植食动物，体长约2.3米，生活在约2.3亿年前晚三叠世的波兰，是最早期恐龙的近亲，也可能是一种早期鸟臀类恐龙。它用四条细长的腿行走，长脖子上顶着一个小脑袋，下颌前端没有牙齿，像喙一样。它大概吃植物和甲虫，遇到危险就靠奔跑逃脱。

entries.k: A slender, monitor-lizard-like hunter about 1.2 metres long from the Early Permian of Texas, around 280 million years ago. It had a narrow skull with sharp, recurved, blade-like teeth, long legs and a long tail, and was more agile than most early synapsids. Despite its lizard-like look it was a synapsid, distantly related to mammals. Bite marks on one Varanops skeleton are among the oldest known evidence of scavenging.
entries.v: 一种体形修长、类似巨蜥的猎手，体长约1.2米，来自得克萨斯州早二叠世，距今约2.8亿年。它头骨狭窄，长着锋利、向后弯曲的刃状牙齿，四肢和尾巴都很长，比大多数早期合弓类更加敏捷。尽管外形像蜥蜴，它却是合弓类，与哺乳动物有远亲关系。一具似巨蜥龙骨骼上的咬痕是已知最古老的食腐证据之一。

entries.k: A slender, soft-bodied polyp a few centimetres long from the roughly 520-million-year-old Chengjiang biota of Yunnan, China, with a ring of eight long tentacles around its mouth. Described in 2022, it is thought to be an early relative of sea anemones and corals, and probably anchored itself by burrowing into the mud. One fossil holds a lingulid brachiopod in its tentacles, the oldest direct evidence of an animal catching large prey.
entries.v: 来自中国云南约5.2亿年前澄江生物群的细长软体水螅型动物，长几厘米，口周围环绕着八条长触手。它于2022年被命名，被认为是海葵和珊瑚的早期近亲，可能通过钻入泥中固定身体。一件化石的触手间夹着一枚舌形贝，这是动物捕食较大猎物的最古老直接证据。

entries.k: A slimmer relative of the bell Trichonympha, named for the collar-like constriction behind its rostrum, living alongside other gut flagellates in the hindgut of dampwood termites. Like its relatives it swallows wood particles and digests their cellulose for its host. These protists are passed between termites when nestmates feed each other from the hindgut, and must be regained after every moult.
entries.v: 钟形披发虫的一个较纤细的近亲，因吻部后方领圈状的缢缩而得名，与其他肠道鞭毛虫一同生活在湿木白蚁的后肠中。与近亲一样，它吞食木屑并为宿主消化其中的纤维素。巢伴之间通过后肠互相喂食时，这些原生生物得以在白蚁间传递，每次蜕皮后都必须重新获得。

entries.k: A slipper-shaped ciliate about a quarter of a millimetre long, rowing through ponds on thousands of beating cilia and sweeping bacteria into its oral groove. Like most protists it leaves no fossils; it stands in for the ancient freshwater plankton.
entries.v: 一种拖鞋形的纤毛虫，长约四分之一毫米，靠数千根摆动的纤毛在池塘中划行，并将细菌扫入口沟。与大多数原生生物一样，它不留下化石；它在此代表古老的淡水浮游生物。

entries.k: A slow, gentle grazer of warm coasts and rivers from Florida to Brazil that can eat a tenth of its body weight in seagrass a day. Sea cows are distant relatives of elephants; their lineage goes back to the Eocene.
entries.v: 一种行动缓慢、性情温和的食草动物，生活在从佛罗里达到巴西的温暖海岸和河流中，每天可吃掉相当于体重十分之一的海草。海牛是大象的远亲，其谱系可追溯到始新世。

entries.k: A slow-growing Caribbean coral whose boulder-shaped colonies are covered in maze-like grooves, each groove lined with polyps. Large heads can be several hundred years old and help build the backbone of the reef.
entries.v: 一种生长缓慢的加勒比珊瑚，巨石状的群体表面布满迷宫般的沟槽，每条沟槽内都排列着珊瑚虫。大型群体可达数百岁，是构建珊瑚礁骨架的重要成员。

entries.k: A slug-like Burgess Shale animal up to about 5 cm long, covered in rows of overlapping, ribbed scales with two rows of tall, blade-like spines along its back. It crawled on a soft sole and scraped the microbial film on the mud with a toothed feeding apparatus much like a mollusc's radula. Its relatives have been argued over for decades, but most researchers now see it as an early mollusc or a close relative.
entries.v: 伯吉斯页岩中一种形似蛞蝓的动物，体长可达约5厘米，身上覆盖着成排重叠、带肋纹的鳞片，背部有两列高耸的刀刃状棘刺。它用柔软的腹足爬行，用一套很像软体动物齿舌的带齿摄食器刮食泥面上的微生物膜。它的亲缘关系争论了几十年，但如今多数研究者认为它是一种早期软体动物或其近亲。

entries.k: A slug-like animal up to about 8 cm long from Sirius Passet in northern Greenland, covered in a coat of mail made of some two thousand small overlapping scales, with a rounded shell at each end of its back. It crawled over the seabed grazing microbial films, and it is thought to be an early relative of molluscs or brachiopods. Wrapped in armour from head to tail, it shrugs off most attacks, but it is slow and has no weapons.
entries.v: 一种蛞蝓状动物，体长可达约 8 厘米，来自格陵兰北部的西里斯帕塞特，全身披着由约两千枚相互叠覆的小骨片构成的“锁子甲”，背部两端各有一枚圆形贝壳。它在海底爬行，啃食微生物膜，被认为是软体动物或腕足动物的早期亲戚。它从头到尾都裹着铠甲，能挡住大多数攻击，但行动缓慢，也没有武器。

entries.k: A small anaspid, a jawless fish about 10 cm long, from the Silurian of Lesmahagow and the Hagshaw Hills in southern Scotland, about 430 million years ago. Its deep body was covered in rows of narrow scales, with a crest of hooked scales along its back and a row of small gill openings behind each eye. Its tail bent down into a large lower lobe. It probably fed on small food particles near the sea floor.
entries.v: 一种小型缺甲鱼，是一种长约10厘米的无颌鱼，来自苏格兰南部莱斯马黑戈和哈格肖丘陵的志留纪地层，距今约4.3亿年。它高高的身体覆盖着一排排狭长的鳞片，背部有一列钩状鳞片形成的脊冠，每只眼睛后面有一排小鳃孔。它的尾部向下弯折形成一个大的下叶。它可能在海底附近取食细小的食物颗粒。

entries.k: A small armoured placoderm from the Middle Devonian lakes of northern Scotland, about 385 million years ago, and a smaller, earlier relative of Dunkleosteus. About 40 centimetres long, it had a jointed head-and-thorax shield covered in tubercles, sharp bony jaw plates instead of teeth, and a naked, tapering tail. Its neck joint let it lift its head and open its jaws very wide to swallow other fish.
entries.v: 一种来自苏格兰北部中泥盆世湖泊的小型披甲盾皮鱼，距今约3.85亿年，是邓氏鱼体型较小、出现较早的亲戚。它体长约40厘米，有一副布满瘤突、可活动关节相连的头胸甲，用锋利的骨质颌板代替牙齿，尾部裸露而逐渐变细。它的颈关节让它能抬起头部，把嘴张得极大，吞下其他鱼类。

entries.k: A small bat from the middle Eocene Messel pit in Germany, with a wingspan of about 30 cm and among the commonest fossils there. Its short, broad wings suited slow, agile flight low over the lake and under the trees, and its stomach contents show it ate moths and caddisflies. Pigment cells preserved in its fur indicate it was reddish-brown.
entries.v: 一种来自德国中始新世梅塞尔坑的小型蝙蝠，翼展约30厘米，是当地最常见的化石之一。它短而宽的翅膀适合在湖面低空和树下缓慢而灵活地飞行，胃容物显示它以蛾类和石蛾为食。毛皮中保存的色素细胞表明它呈红棕色。

entries.k: A small bat of Central and South America that feeds only on blood, mostly from livestock and other large mammals. It lands near sleeping prey, runs and hops nimbly on its thumbs and hind legs, finds a warm spot with heat sensors on its nose, and laps blood from a tiny cut kept open by anticoagulant saliva. Roost-mates that failed to feed are given a shared meal of regurgitated blood.
entries.v: 一种生活在中南美洲的小型蝙蝠，只以血液为食，主要吸食家畜和其他大型哺乳动物的血。它降落在熟睡的猎物附近，用拇指和后肢灵巧地奔跑跳跃，借鼻部的热感受器找到温暖的部位，然后从被抗凝唾液保持开放的小伤口中舔血。没能吸到血的同伴会获得反刍出的血液共享。

entries.k: A small blind trilobite from the Early Ordovician Fezouata Shale of Morocco, with a body under 2 cm long. A long spine projected forward from its head and two more swept back from its cheeks. Fossils show groups of Ampyx lined up in single file, each touching the one in front with its spines: probably a collective migration, perhaps triggered by storms, and among the oldest evidence of group behaviour in animals.
entries.v: 一种小型盲三叶虫，来自摩洛哥早奥陶世的费祖阿塔页岩，身体长不到2厘米。一根长刺从头部向前伸出，另有两根从颊部向后掠。化石显示，成群的Ampyx排成单列纵队，每只都用棘刺碰触前面一只：这很可能是一次集体迁徙，也许由风暴引发，是动物群体行为最古老的证据之一。

entries.k: A small blind trilobite, usually 2-4 cm long, from Ordovician mudstones of Wales and the Welsh Borderland, and the type species of its genus. Its swollen head is ringed by a broad fringe pierced by concentric rows of pits, and long spines trail behind it. Nobody is sure what the fringe was for: ideas include sifting food from the sediment, sensing the water, and keeping the animal from sinking into soft mud.
entries.v: 一种体长通常2-4厘米的小型盲眼三叶虫，见于威尔士及威尔士边区的奥陶纪泥岩，是三瘤虫属的模式种。它膨大的头部周围环绕着一圈宽阔的缘边，上面排列着一圈圈同心的小坑，身后拖着长长的颊刺。这圈缘边的功能至今不明：有人认为它用来从沉积物中筛滤食物，有人认为它能感知水流，也有人认为它能防止身体陷入软泥。

entries.k: A small burrowing palaeanodont from the Oligocene of North America, about 20 cm long and a distant relative of pangolins. Built like a golden mole, it had a shovel-like snout, tiny eyes and huge claws on its short forelimbs for tunnelling through loose sand after ants and termites. Hidden underground, it was very hard for predators to reach.
entries.v: 一种来自北美渐新世的小型穴居古无齿类，体长约20厘米，是穿山甲的远亲。它的身体构造像金鼹，有铲子般的吻部、极小的眼睛，短短的前肢上长着巨大的爪子，用来在松散的沙土中挖掘隧道，寻找蚂蚁和白蚁。它藏身地下，掠食者很难捉到它。

entries.k: A small chain coral described in 1966 from earliest Silurian rocks of Estonia, known from drill cores. Its small colonies had rounded corallites about 1.5 mm across, a little smaller than those of the common chain coral, enclosing small, rounded windows. The scientist who described it later treated it as the same species as Halysites catenularia, so it may simply be an early form of that coral.
entries.v: 一种小型链珊瑚，1966年根据爱沙尼亚最早志留世地层的钻孔岩芯描述。它的小群体由直径约1.5毫米的圆形珊瑚个体组成，比普通链珊瑚略小，围出小而圆的空窗。命名者后来把它视为与链珊瑚（Halysites catenularia）同一物种，因此它可能只是该珊瑚的早期类型。

entries.k: A small chimaeroid, an early relative of today's ratfish, from the Bear Gulch Limestone of Montana, about 320 million years old. Males grew to about 15 cm and females to only half that, and males bore rows of short spines over the head and back. It had a big blunt head, large eyes, broad pectoral fins and a paddle-like tail, so it was probably a slow swimmer that picked small invertebrates off the bottom of the bay.
entries.v: 一种小型银鲛类，是现今银鲛的早期亲属，来自蒙大拿州的熊峡灰岩，距今约3.2亿年。雄性体长约15厘米，雌性只有其一半，雄性的头部和背部长着成排的短刺。它有钝圆的大头、大眼睛、宽阔的胸鳍和桨状尾巴，因此可能游得很慢，在海湾底部捕食小型无脊椎动物。

entries.k: A small compsognathid about 1 metre long, more than half of it tail, from the Yixian Formation of north-eastern China, about 125 million years ago. Described in 1996, it was the first non-bird dinosaur found with a coat of feather-like filaments. Melanosomes show it was reddish-brown above and pale below, with a dark mask across its eyes and a tail ringed in ginger and white. One specimen has a lizard in its stomach.
entries.v: 一种小型美颌龙类，体长约1米，一半以上是尾巴，出自中国东北的义县组，距今约1.25亿年。它于1996年被描述，是第一种被发现身披羽毛状细丝的非鸟恐龙。黑色素体显示它背部为红褐色、腹部色浅，眼部有一道深色的“面罩”，尾巴上有姜黄色与白色相间的环纹。有一件标本的胃里有一只蜥蜴。

entries.k: A small dicynodont about 45 cm long, one of the most common animals of the Late Permian Karoo of South Africa, around 258 million years ago; it is also known from China. It cropped plants with a horny beak, and many individuals had a pair of small tusks. It dug spiral burrows with its clawed forelimbs, and skeletons have been found curled up inside them, sometimes in pairs. Its name means 'two weasel teeth'.
entries.v: 一种体长约45厘米的小型二齿兽类，是南非晚二叠世卡鲁地区最常见的动物之一，距今约2.58亿年；在中国也有发现。它用角质喙啃食植物，许多个体长着一对小獠牙。它用带爪的前肢挖掘螺旋形洞穴，人们曾在洞中发现蜷缩着的骨骼，有时还是成对的。它的名字意为“两颗鼬齿”。

entries.k: A small fringed trilobite from the Late Ordovician of Scandinavia, especially Norway and Sweden. It is now usually placed in the genus Tretaspis, of which it is the type species. A raised ridge splits its pitted fringe into outer and inner bands; it has small eye bumps but probably could not see, and its very long, thin cheek spines inspired the name 'seticornis', meaning 'bristle-horned'.
entries.v: 一种来自晚奥陶世斯堪的纳维亚（尤其是挪威和瑞典）的小型缘边三叶虫，现在通常被归入孔盾虫属（Tretaspis），并且是该属的模式种。一道隆起的脊把它布满小坑的缘边分成内外两带；它有小小的眼瘤，但很可能看不见东西。它那极长而纤细的颊刺正是种名“seticornis”（意为“刚毛之角”）的由来。

entries.k: A small gliding reptile about 20 centimetres long including its tail, from New Jersey about 220 million years ago. Like the living flying lizard Draco, it had very long ribs sticking out sideways from its body that held up skin wings, letting it glide from tree to tree. It ate insects and was far too small and fragile to fight, escaping instead by launching itself into the air.
entries.v: 一种小型滑翔爬行动物，连尾巴在内长约20厘米，约2.2亿年前生活在美国新泽西州。它和现生的飞蜥一样，身体两侧伸出很长的肋骨，撑起皮膜翼，能在树木之间滑翔。它以昆虫为食，身体太小太脆弱，无法战斗，遇险时便纵身跃入空中逃走。

entries.k: A small hard tick of eastern North American woodlands, also called the deer tick, and the main carrier of the bacteria that cause Lyme disease. Over a two-year life it takes three blood meals: larvae and nymphs mostly on mice, birds and lizards, adults on white-tailed deer. It waits for each host by 'questing' on low plants with its front legs held out.
entries.v: 一种生活在北美东部林地的小型硬蜱，又称鹿蜱，是莱姆病病原菌的主要携带者。在两年的生命中它要吸三次血：幼蜱和若蜱主要吸食鼠类、鸟类和蜥蜴，成蜱则吸食白尾鹿。它伏在低矮植物上伸出前足“寻觅”，等待每一个宿主。

entries.k: A small herring of the early Eocene Green River lakes of Wyoming, usually 10-15 cm long and one of the most common fossil fish in the world; whole schools are preserved together in the lake beds. It fed on plankton and small insects and was eaten by gars, larger fish, birds and turtles.
entries.v: 一种小型鲱鱼，生活在早始新世怀俄明州的绿河古湖中，体长通常为10至15厘米，是世界上最常见的鱼类化石之一；湖床沉积中常保存着整群鱼。它以浮游生物和小型昆虫为食，是雀鳝、较大的鱼类、鸟类和龟类的食物。

entries.k: A small horseshoe crab a few centimetres long, common among the Mazon Creek fossils of Illinois, about 309 million years old. Its broad, crescent-shaped head shield ended in long, backswept spines, and its fused hind shield was fringed with short spines in front of a long tail spike. Unlike today's horseshoe crabs it lived in fresh and brackish coal-swamp waters, and some researchers think it could even clamber about on plants out of the water.
entries.v: 一种体长几厘米的小型鲎，在约3.09亿年前美国伊利诺伊州的马森溪化石中很常见。它宽阔的新月形头盾末端有向后伸展的长刺，愈合的后盾边缘在长尾剑前方镶着一圈短刺。与今天的鲎不同，它生活在煤沼的淡水和半咸水中，一些研究者认为它甚至能离开水在植物上攀爬。

entries.k: A small hummingbird of cloud forest and shrubby páramo edges high in the Andes, from Venezuela to Bolivia. Males are dark bronze-green with a glittering green throat and the violet-to-coppery tail that gives the metaltails their name. Its short bill often pierces the base of long flowers to steal nectar, and on cold mountain nights it drops into torpor to save energy.
entries.v: 一种小型蜂鸟，生活在从委内瑞拉到玻利维亚的安第斯山高处的云雾林和灌丛帕拉莫边缘。雄鸟呈深古铜绿色，喉部闪耀着绿色光泽，尾羽由紫罗兰色渐变为铜色，“金属尾蜂鸟”之名即源于此。它的短喙常刺穿长花的基部盗取花蜜，在寒冷的山间夜晚会进入蛰伏以节省能量。

entries.k: A small insectivore from the middle Eocene of Europe, best known from complete skeletons from the Messel pit, 60-90 cm long including a tail longer than its body. Its long hind legs and short arms suggest it ran or hopped on two legs over the forest floor, and it probed for insects, lizards and small mammals with a long, mobile snout. It belonged to the leptictids, an extinct side branch of early placental mammals.
entries.v: 一种来自欧洲中始新世的小型食虫动物，以梅塞尔坑出土的完整骨架最为著名，连同比身体还长的尾巴在内长60-90厘米。它长长的后腿和短小的前肢表明它可能在林地上用两足奔跑或跳跃，并用长而灵活的吻部探寻昆虫、蜥蜴和小型哺乳动物。它属于细鼩类，是早期有胎盘哺乳动物中一个已灭绝的旁支。

entries.k: A small land leech of damp mountain forests in Japan that waits on the forest floor and low plants for passing animals. It senses their warmth, breath and movement, loops toward them like an inchworm and sucks the blood of deer, wild boar and people. It has become more common in places where growing deer populations carry it around.
entries.v: 一种生活在日本潮湿山地森林中的小型陆生水蛭，在林地和低矮植物上等待路过的动物。它能感知动物的体温、呼吸和动作，像尺蠖一样一屈一伸地靠近，吸食鹿、野猪和人的血。在鹿群数量增长、将其四处携带的地方，它变得越来越常见。

entries.k: A small lingulid brachiopod about a centimetre long from the roughly 518-million-year-old Chengjiang biota of Yunnan, China. Its two thin, oval valves were made of calcium phosphate and protein rather than calcite. Because Chengjiang preserves soft tissue, its fossils still show the fringe of bristles around the shell margin and the long, fleshy stalk, or pedicle, that anchored it to the seabed, sometimes onto other shells. It strained food particles from the water with a ring of tentacles, the lophophore, inside the shell.
entries.v: 一种体长约1厘米的小型舌形贝类腕足动物，出自中国云南约5.18亿年前的澄江生物群。它两片薄而呈椭圆形的壳瓣由磷酸钙和蛋白质构成，而非方解石。由于澄江生物群保存了软组织，其化石仍可见壳缘周围的一圈刚毛，以及将它固着在海底（有时附着在其他贝壳上）的长而肉质的柄，即肉茎。它用壳内一圈名为触手冠的触手从水中滤取食物颗粒。

entries.k: A small lizard-like reptile, its body only about 15 cm long, known from a single partial skeleton from the Triassic Madygen Formation of Kyrgyzstan, about 230 million years ago. A row of long, hockey-stick-shaped appendages, each longer than its body, grew from its back; they are usually reconstructed as a fan of display plumes. It was once wrongly claimed to be a feathered ancestor of birds, and its relationships among reptiles are still uncertain. It probably climbed in trees and caught insects.
entries.v: 一种形似蜥蜴的小型爬行动物，身体仅长约15厘米，仅凭一具出自吉尔吉斯斯坦三叠纪马迪根组（距今约2.3亿年）的不完整骨骼为人所知。它背上长着一排曲棍球杆状的长附肢，每根都比身体还长，通常被复原成一排展示用的扇状羽饰。它曾被错误地认为是带羽毛的鸟类祖先，它在爬行动物中的亲缘关系至今仍不确定。它可能在树上攀爬并捕食昆虫。

entries.k: A small millipede from near Stonehaven in Scotland, dated to about 425 million years ago, one of the oldest land animals known. Its body rings carry spiracles, the openings of breathing tubes, the earliest direct evidence of an animal breathing air. It lived among the first low plants beside lakes and fed on rotting plant matter; like living millipedes it could probably curl up inside its hard rings when attacked.
entries.v: 一种小型马陆，发现于苏格兰斯通黑文附近，年代约为4.25亿年前，是已知最古老的陆生动物之一。它的体节上有气门，即呼吸管的开口，这是动物呼吸空气的最早直接证据。它生活在湖边最早的低矮植物之间，以腐烂的植物为食；和现生马陆一样，它受到攻击时可能会蜷缩在坚硬的体环里。

entries.k: A small palaeodictyopteran insect from the Early Permian of Kansas, around 275 million years ago, with a wingspan of only a few centimetres. Its four broad wings, held straight out like those of a dragonfly, were boldly crossed by dark bands, and it used a sharp, beak-like mouth to pierce plants and suck their sap. Agile in the air and breeding in great numbers, it survived by flying off and swarming rather than by fighting.
entries.v: 一种小型古网翅目昆虫，生活在约 2.75 亿年前二叠纪早期的美国堪萨斯，翼展只有几厘米。它像蜻蜓一样平展的四片宽大翅膀上横贯着醒目的深色条带，并用尖锐的喙状口器刺入植物吸食汁液。它在空中灵活自如，繁殖数量庞大，靠飞走和成群活动而不是战斗求生。

entries.k: A small pareiasaur, only about 60 centimetres long, from the Late Permian of northern Scotland, around 255 million years ago. Its compact, armoured body was studded with bony knobs, and its head bristled with the most elaborate set of horns and spikes of any pareiasaur, including a pair of long horns at the back of the skull. A slow plant-eater, it relied on this spiky armour rather than speed, which made it a very painful mouthful for any predator.
entries.v: 一种小型锯齿龙，体长仅约 60 厘米，生活在约 2.55 亿年前二叠纪晚期的苏格兰北部。它紧凑的身体披着盔甲、布满骨质瘤突，头上长满所有锯齿龙中最繁复的角和棘刺，其中包括头骨后部一对长角。作为行动缓慢的植食动物，它依靠这身带刺的盔甲而不是速度自保，任何掠食者咬上一口都会吃尽苦头。

entries.k: A small planktonic graptolite of the Early Ordovician, shaped like a tuning fork: two slender branches hang from the founding zooid's cone, each lined with saw-toothed tubes that housed filter-feeding zooids. Graptolites were colonial hemichordates related to modern pterobranchs, and because their species changed fast and drifted across whole oceans, two-branched didymograptids like this one are key index fossils for dating Ordovician rocks.
entries.v: 早奥陶世的一种小型浮游笔石，形如音叉：两根细长的枝从始个虫的胎管上垂下，每根枝上排列着锯齿状的胞管，内居滤食性个虫。笔石是群体生活的半索动物，与现代羽鳃类有亲缘关系；由于其物种演变迅速且漂流遍及整个大洋，像这样的双枝对笔石类是确定奥陶纪地层年代的关键标准化石。

entries.k: A small predatory flagellate of seas and lakes that swims with two unequal flagella and swallows bacteria and smaller flagellates whole. Telonemids are a deep branch of their own, next to the great group of the ciliates, foraminifera, diatoms and brown algae, the SAR, within the Diaphoretickes, which also holds the red and green algae and the plants. It stands here for the ancestor of that whole branch, over a billion years old.
entries.v: 一种生活在海洋和湖泊中的小型捕食性鞭毛虫，靠两根长短不一的鞭毛游动，能把细菌和更小的鞭毛虫整个吞下。泰罗虫类自成一个古老的深分支，紧邻由纤毛虫、有孔虫、硅藻和褐藻组成的庞大类群——SAR超类群，同属双有鞭毛生物（Diaphoretickes）；后者还包括红藻、绿藻和植物。它在这里代表这一整支距今超过十亿年的祖先。

entries.k: A small ptyctodont placoderm from the Late Devonian Gogo reef of Western Australia, about 380 million years ago, named in honour of David Attenborough. Its fossil, the 'mother fish', contains an embryo still joined to it by an umbilical cord, the oldest known evidence of live birth in any vertebrate. About 25 centimetres long, it had big eyes, beak-like crushing tooth plates for shellfish and a long, whip-like tail.
entries.v: 一种小型褶齿鱼类盾皮鱼，来自西澳大利亚晚泥盆世的戈戈礁，距今约3.8亿年，以大卫·爱登堡的名字命名。它的化石被称为"母鱼"，体内有一个仍以脐带相连的胚胎，这是所有脊椎动物中已知最古老的胎生证据。它体长约25厘米，眼睛很大，有用于压碎贝类的喙状齿板，还有一条长长的鞭状尾巴。

entries.k: A small radiodont about 6 cm long from the Chengjiang biota of Yunnan, China, about 518 million years old, its name meaning "lyre-tailed predator with claw-like spines". Its frontal limbs carried long, curved spines that worked like grasping claws, and some fossils even preserve its brain. Quick, sharp-eyed and armed with those claws, it struck hard for its size, but its small body could not take much punishment.
entries.v: 一种体长约 6 厘米的小型放射齿目动物，来自约 5.18 亿年前中国云南的澄江生物群，学名意为“长着爪状刺的琴尾掠食者”。它的前附肢上长着又长又弯的刺，像抓握的利爪，有些化石甚至保存了它的大脑。它敏捷、目光锐利，又有这些利爪，以体型而论攻击力很强，但小小的身体经不起重创。

entries.k: A small reddish-brown ant from the floodplains of central South America that has spread to the southern United States, Australia, China and elsewhere, mostly with shipped soil and plants. Colonies build loose earth mounds and swarm out to defend them, stinging repeatedly with a venom that leaves itchy pustules. During floods the workers link their bodies into living rafts that carry the queen and brood to dry land.
entries.v: 一种来自南美洲中部泛滥平原的红褐色小蚂蚁，主要随运输的土壤和植物扩散到美国南部、澳大利亚、中国等地。蚁群筑起松散的土丘，一旦受扰便蜂拥而出防御，反复叮蜇，毒液会留下瘙痒的脓疱。洪水来临时，工蚁们以身体相连组成活筏，将蚁后和幼虫运送到干燥的陆地。

entries.k: A small reef fish of the Indian and Pacific Oceans that feeds almost only on coral polyps, usually in faithful pairs. The black bar through its eye hides the real eye from predators.
entries.v: 一种生活在印度洋和太平洋的小型礁鱼，几乎只以珊瑚虫为食，通常成对忠诚相伴。穿过眼睛的黑色条纹能向捕食者隐藏真正的眼睛。

entries.k: A small relative of the ratfishes, about 40 centimetres long, from the Late Carboniferous seas of North America, about 305 million years ago. It had a short body, huge eyes and enormous wing-like pectoral fins set high on the shoulders, their leading edges armed with hooked denticles. It may have used these fins to burst out of the water and glide like a flying fish. Fast and hard to catch, it was easily hurt once caught.
entries.v: 一种银鲛的小型亲戚，体长约40厘米，生活在约3.05亿年前北美的晚石炭世海洋中。它身体短小，眼睛巨大，高高长在肩部的胸鳍大得像翅膀，前缘长着一排钩状小齿。它可能用这对鳍冲出水面，像飞鱼一样滑翔。它速度快、难以捕捉，但一旦被抓住就很容易受伤。

entries.k: A small reptile about 25 centimetres long from the Early Permian of central Germany, around 290 million years ago, and the oldest known animal able to run on two legs. Its hind legs were much longer than its arms and it ran on its toes, holding its long tail out behind as a counterbalance. A plant-eater, it escaped predators by sprinting away on its hind legs, but it was too small and frail to fight back.
entries.v: 一种小型爬行动物，体长约 25 厘米，生活在约 2.9 亿年前二叠纪早期的德国中部，是已知最古老的能用两条腿奔跑的动物。它的后肢远比前肢长，用脚趾奔跑，长尾向后伸直以保持平衡。作为植食动物，它靠后肢疾跑逃离掠食者，但体型太小、太脆弱，无力反击。

entries.k: A small ring-shaped animal 0.5 to 2 cm across with raised spiral ridges, named after Barack Obama and found in dense clusters in 550-million-year-old rocks of South Australia. It sat partly sunk into the tough microbial mat on the seabed, and nothing quite like it is known from any other time. Its stiff, embedded ring is hard to dislodge, and its crowded beds quickly fill the space around it, but it cannot attack.
entries.v: 一种直径 0.5 到 2 厘米的小型环状动物，表面有隆起的螺旋脊，以巴拉克·奥巴马命名，在南澳大利亚 5.5 亿年前的岩层中密集成群地出现。它部分嵌在海底坚韧的微生物席中，其他任何时代都没有发现与它相似的生物。它坚硬的嵌入式环体很难被撼动，密集的群落能迅速占满周围空间，但它无法攻击。

entries.k: A small scorpion only a few centimetres long from the Early Devonian seas of western Germany, about 400 million years ago. Rows of feathery, gill-like flaps along the sides of its body show that it lived and breathed under water, long after scorpions first appeared. Armed with grasping pincers and a venomous sting, it struck very hard for its size, but its slender body was fragile.
entries.v: 一种只有几厘米长的小型蝎子，来自约4亿年前德国西部的早泥盆世海洋。它身体两侧成排的羽状鳃形瓣片表明，在蝎子最早出现很久之后，它仍生活并呼吸于水下。它配备抓握用的螯和有毒的尾刺，以其体型而言攻击力极强，但纤细的身体十分脆弱。

entries.k: A small sea lily from the Late Ordovician (Katian) of the Cincinnati region. Its small cup was held above the sea floor on a long, ridged stem anchored by a root-like holdfast, and its five arms branched repeatedly into a fan that caught food particles drifting in the current. Whole crinoids like it are sometimes found tangled together in 'logjams', smothered by storm-stirred mud.
entries.v: 一种小型海百合，产自辛辛那提地区的晚奥陶世（凯特期）地层。它小小的萼部由一根带棱脊的长茎托举在海底之上，茎由根状固着器固定；五条腕反复分叉，形成扇形，捕捉随水流漂来的食物颗粒。像它这样完整的海百合有时会成堆缠结在一起，形成“原木堆”，是被风暴搅起的泥沙闷死后掩埋的。

entries.k: A small sea snail, about 2 cm high, very common in Late Ordovician rocks of Ohio, Indiana and Kentucky. Its top-shaped shell had a few rounded whorls and a large round opening, and was covered in fine spiral ridges crossed by growth lines. It probably crept over the sea floor grazing on microbial films and organic debris.
entries.v: 一种小型海螺，高约2厘米，在美国俄亥俄、印第安纳和肯塔基三州的晚奥陶世岩层中非常常见。它的陀螺形外壳有几圈圆润的螺环和一个大而圆的壳口，表面布满细密的螺旋脊，并与生长线交错。它很可能在海底缓慢爬行，啃食微生物膜和有机碎屑。

entries.k: A small shark about 30 cm long from the Bear Gulch Limestone of Montana, laid down in a tropical bay about 320 million years ago. Mature males carried a sword-shaped spine that grew from the shoulders and curved forward over the head, perhaps used in courtship, while females lacked it. With its very large eyes it probably hunted small fish and invertebrates, and some fossils preserve a male with a female apparently gripping his spine.
entries.v: 一种体长约30厘米的小型鲨鱼，出自蒙大拿州的熊峡石灰岩，这些石灰岩约3.2亿年前沉积于一个热带海湾。成年雄性背负一根剑形棘刺，从肩部长出并向前弯过头顶，可能用于求偶，而雌性没有。它眼睛很大，可能捕食小鱼和无脊椎动物；有些化石保存了一只雄性，旁边的雌性似乎正咬住它的棘刺。

entries.k: A small spiny worm on stilt-like clawed legs, related to modern velvet worms, with seven pairs of protective spines along its back. It was famously first reconstructed upside down and back to front, with the spines taken for legs; its small head with simple eyes and a ring of teeth was only identified in 2015.
entries.v: 一种长着高跷般带爪腿的小型带刺蠕虫，与现代天鹅绒虫有亲缘关系，背部有七对防御性棘刺。它最初的复原图出了名地上下颠倒、前后反置，把棘刺当成了腿；直到2015年，人们才辨认出它带有单眼和一圈牙齿的小脑袋。

entries.k: A small sponge from the Burgess Shale of British Columbia, about 505 million years old: a low cone about 2 cm across made of fine radiating spicules, ringed by long, stiff spicules that bring its total width to about 5 cm. It was not attached but sat loose on the mud, its spicule fringe probably keeping it above the sea floor while it filtered food from the water. It belongs to an early branch of the demosponges, the group that includes modern bath sponges.
entries.v: 来自加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省伯吉斯页岩的小型海绵，生活在约5.05亿年前：身体是一个直径约2厘米的低矮圆锥，由细密的放射状骨针构成，周围环绕着长而硬的骨针，使总宽度达到约5厘米。它并不固着，而是松散地躺在泥地上，骨针边缘可能把它撑离海底，以便滤食水中的食物。它属于寻常海绵的早期分支，现代的沐浴海绵也属于这一类群。

entries.k: A small swimming arthropod about 3 cm long from the Chengjiang biota of Yunnan, China, enclosed in a thin two-halved shell drawn out into long spines at the front and back. It had big round eyes and a pair of spiny grasping limbs to catch small animals as it swam in open water. Fast and keen-sighted, it moves and hunts well, but its light shell gives only modest protection.
entries.v: 一种体长约 3 厘米的小型游泳节肢动物，来自中国云南的澄江生物群，包裹在薄薄的双瓣壳中，壳的前后两端延伸成长刺。它有一双又大又圆的眼睛和一对多刺的抓握肢，在开阔水域游动时捕捉小动物。它速度快、视力敏锐，善于游动和捕猎，但轻薄的外壳只能提供有限的保护。

entries.k: A small temnospondyl amphibian about 12 cm long from the Mazon Creek fossil beds of Illinois, about 309 million years old. It had a broad, rounded head with huge eye sockets, a short body and slender legs, and its fossils include larvae with gills, so it grew up in the water like a salamander. Amphibamus is one of the closest known Palaeozoic relatives of modern frogs and salamanders, and probably snapped up insects and other small invertebrates.
entries.v: 一种长约12厘米的小型离片椎类两栖动物，来自美国伊利诺伊州的梅森溪化石层，距今约3.09亿年。它的头部宽而圆，眼眶巨大，身体短，四肢纤细；其化石中包括带鳃的幼体，说明它像蝾螈一样在水中长大。双栖螈是已知与现代蛙类和蝾螈关系最近的古生代近亲之一，可能以昆虫和其他小型无脊椎动物为食。

entries.k: A small therocephalian about 45 centimetres long from the Late Permian of South Africa, around 256 million years ago. Its short, broad skull had a deep pit in front of each eye, linked to its long, ridged canines, which many scientists think held a venom gland. If so, it is the oldest known venomous four-legged animal, able to subdue prey far larger than its size would suggest. Its small, lightly built body offered little protection.
entries.v: 一种小型兽头类，体长约 45 厘米，生活在约 2.56 亿年前二叠纪晚期的南非。它短而宽的头骨上，每只眼睛前方都有一个深坑，与长而带棱的犬齿相连，许多科学家认为坑内容纳着毒腺。若果真如此，它就是已知最古老的有毒四足动物，能够制服远比其体型所暗示的更大的猎物。它小巧轻盈的身体几乎没有防护。

entries.k: A small tick native to East Asia and long established in Australia and New Zealand, where it is a pest of cattle. Many populations are all female and reproduce parthenogenetically, each laying thousands of eggs without mating, so one tick can start a dense infestation. First found in the United States in 2017, it has since spread across much of the eastern states.
entries.v: 一种原产东亚的小型蜱，早已在澳大利亚和新西兰定居，是当地的牛害。许多种群全为雌性，以孤雌生殖繁衍，每只无需交配即可产下数千枚卵，因此一只蜱就能引发严重的虫害。它于2017年首次在美国发现，此后已扩散到东部大部分州。

entries.k: A small titanosaur about 12 metres long from Argentina about 70 million years ago, and the first sauropod found to have body armour. Its back was studded with bony plates up to 12 cm across set in a mosaic of small bony nodules. Females may have laid their eggs in huge nesting colonies, like those found nearby at Auca Mahuevo.
entries.v: 一种体长约12米的小型泰坦巨龙，约7000万年前生活在阿根廷，是第一种被发现长有体甲的蜥脚类恐龙。它的背部点缀着直径可达12厘米的骨板，镶嵌在由小骨结组成的马赛克中。雌性可能在巨大的筑巢地集体产卵，就像在附近奥卡马韦沃发现的那样。

entries.k: A small whale related to narwhals from the Late Miocene and Pliocene of Peru that evolved a walrus-like face. It had a blunt, beakless snout with a muscular upper lip for sucking clams from the sea floor, eyes facing forward and up, and two tusks pointing backwards along the body; in males the right tusk was much longer, over a metre.
entries.v: 一种与一角鲸有亲缘关系的小型鲸类，出自秘鲁晚中新世和上新世地层，演化出了类似海象的面部。它的吻部钝圆无喙，有肌肉发达的上唇，用来从海底吸食蛤蜊；双眼朝前上方；两根獠牙沿身体向后伸；雄性的右侧獠牙要长得多，超过1米。

entries.k: A small whip spider from the Middle Coal Measures of Coseley in England, about 315 million years old, long known as Graeophonus anglicus. Like modern amblypygids it had a flat body and used its enormously long, thin first legs as feelers while walking on the other three pairs. Scans of its fossils show the least specialised pedipalps of any whip spider, still moving up and down like walking legs, which it used to seize insects in the leaf litter of the coal forests.
entries.v: 一种小型鞭蛛，出自英格兰科斯利的中煤系地层，距今约3.15亿年，长期以来被称为Graeophonus anglicus。与现代鞭蛛一样，它身体扁平，把极长极细的第一对足当作触角，用其余三对足行走。对其化石的扫描显示，它的须肢是所有鞭蛛中特化程度最低的，仍像步足一样上下运动，它用须肢在煤炭森林的落叶层中捕捉昆虫。

entries.k: A small, common ichthyosaur about 1 metre long from the Middle Triassic of Monte San Giorgio on the Swiss-Italian border and elsewhere, about 242 million years ago. Fossils with traces of soft tissue show it had a tall dorsal fin, one of the earliest in an ichthyosaur, and its tail had a downward bend with a lower lobe. It is often seen as a halfway stage between eel-like early ichthyosaurs and the fast, tuna-shaped later ones, and it hunted fish and squid-like animals with its long, toothed snout.
entries.v: 一种小型常见的鱼龙，体长约1米，生活在约2.42亿年前中三叠世瑞士与意大利边境的圣乔治山及其他地区。带有软组织痕迹的化石显示，它长着高高的背鳍，是最早拥有背鳍的鱼龙之一，尾部向下弯折并带有下叶。它常被视为介于鳗形的早期鱼龙与快速、金枪鱼形的晚期鱼龙之间的过渡阶段，用带齿的长吻捕食鱼类和类似乌贼的动物。

entries.k: A small, early jawed fish a few centimetres long from the early Silurian of Guizhou, China, about 439 million years ago, one of the oldest jawed vertebrates known from more than scattered scales. It was a spiny relative of the earliest sharks, with sharp spines in front of its fins, a bony shoulder armour and a long row of extra paired spines along its belly. Its spines made it very hard to swallow, while its jaws let it catch small prey.
entries.v: 一种小型早期有颌鱼，体长数厘米，生活于约4.39亿年前中国贵州的早志留世，是已知除零散鳞片之外保存最好的最古老有颌脊椎动物之一。它是最早鲨类的多刺亲戚，鳍前长着尖刺，有骨质肩带甲，腹部还有一长排额外的成对棘刺。这些刺使它极难被吞下，而它的颌让它能捕捉小型猎物。

entries.k: A small, eel-like lysorophian amphibian about 30 centimetres long from the Late Carboniferous coal swamps of North America, about 307 million years ago. It had a long body, a small, sturdy head and tiny limbs. When its pools dried out it dug a burrow in the mud and lay curled up inside, waiting for the rains, and fossils of Brachydectes have been found still coiled in their burrows. Hidden underground it survived droughts and attacks that killed other animals.
entries.v: 一种体长约30厘米、形似鳗鱼的小型蛇螈类两栖动物，生活在约3.07亿年前北美的晚石炭世煤沼中。它身体细长，头小而结实，四肢极小。水塘干涸时，它会在泥里挖洞，蜷缩在里面等待雨季，人们发现过仍盘绕在洞穴中的短咬螈化石。藏身地下，它能熬过让其他动物丧命的干旱和攻击。

entries.k: A small, fast ornithischian dinosaur about 1.2 metres long from the Early Jurassic of South Africa, about 200 million years ago. Its name means 'different-toothed lizard': it had a horny beak, chisel-like cheek teeth for chopping plants and a pair of long, fang-like tusks used for display, fighting or eating small animals. Its strong, grasping hands could dig up roots or catch prey, making it quick and surprisingly well armed for its size.
entries.v: 一种小型、敏捷的鸟臀类恐龙，体长约1.2米，约2亿年前生活在南非的早侏罗世。它的名字意为“不同牙齿的蜥蜴”：它有角质喙、用来切碎植物的凿状颊齿，以及一对用于展示、打斗或吃小动物的长獠牙。强壮的抓握型前肢能挖掘根茎或捕捉猎物，使它在这样的体型下行动迅速且武装出奇地好。

entries.k: A small, fast plant-eating dinosaur from the polar forests of southern Australia about 110 million years ago, when the region lay inside the Antarctic Circle and had weeks of winter darkness. Its tail was about three times as long as its body, perhaps wrapped around it for warmth, and its large eye sockets suggest keen sight in the long polar night. It relied on speed and agility to dodge predators.
entries.v: 一种小型、敏捷的植食性恐龙，约1.1亿年前生活在澳大利亚南部的极地森林中，那时该地区位于南极圈内，冬季会有数周的黑暗。它的尾巴约是身体长度的三倍，也许能裹住身体保暖，大大的眼眶表明它在漫长的极夜中视力敏锐。它依靠速度和敏捷躲避掠食者。

entries.k: A small, fox-sized cynodont, about 45 cm long, from the Early Triassic of South Africa and Antarctica, around 250 million years ago, soon after the end-Permian mass extinction. Its teeth were already divided into incisors, canines and cheek teeth, and its ribcage hints that it breathed with a diaphragm, like mammals. Many fossils were found curled up in burrows, one of which it shared with an injured amphibian, suggesting it sheltered underground from the harsh climate.
entries.v: 一种狐狸大小的小型犬齿兽，长约45厘米，来自南非和南极洲的早三叠世，距今约2.5亿年，正值二叠纪末大灭绝之后不久。它的牙齿已分化为门齿、犬齿和颊齿，胸廓暗示它像哺乳动物一样用横膈膜呼吸。许多化石是在洞穴中蜷缩着被发现的，其中一个洞穴里它还与一只受伤的两栖动物同处，这表明它躲在地下以避开恶劣的气候。

entries.k: A small, jellyfish-like animal, only a centimetre or two across, known from a single fossil from the roughly 520-million-year-old Chengjiang biota near Haikou, Yunnan, China. First described in 2007 as a comb jelly because of the dark strips on its bell, it was reinterpreted in 2016 as one of the earliest swimming jellyfish, with 16 lobes around the bell margin, 16 sense organs (rhopalia), 16 pairs of long tentacles and a central mouth tube. If it was a jellyfish it was a drifting predator, though its true identity is still debated.
entries.v: 一种小型的类水母动物，直径仅一两厘米，仅有一件化石标本，产自中国云南海口附近约5.2亿年前的澄江生物群。2007年它因伞部的深色条带被描述为栉水母，2016年又被重新解释为最早的游泳水母之一：伞缘有16个缘瓣、16个感觉器（触手囊）、16对长触手和一根位于中央的口柄。如果它确实是水母，它应是一种随水漂游的捕食者，但它的真实身份仍有争议。

entries.k: A small, lightly built gorgonopsian about 1 metre long from the Late Permian of South Africa, around 255 million years ago; its name means 'wolf face'. It had long, slender, nearly upright legs, a narrow snout and long sabre-like canines. One of the most agile land predators of the Permian, it ran down small dicynodonts and other small animals, but its light build left it fragile in a fight.
entries.v: 一种体型小、身体轻盈的丽齿兽类，体长约 1 米，生活在约 2.55 亿年前二叠纪晚期的南非；它的名字意为“狼面”。它四肢修长、几乎直立，吻部狭窄，长有长长的军刀状犬齿。作为二叠纪最敏捷的陆地掠食者之一，它能追捕小型二齿兽和其他小动物，但轻巧的体格使它在搏斗中十分脆弱。

entries.k: A small, lightly built hoofed mammal of Miocene Patagonia, about 70 cm long, belonging to the litopterns, a South American group unrelated to horses. It evolved a single-toed foot even more reduced than a modern horse's, with the side toes shrunk to tiny splints. It was fast and nimble on its long, thin legs, but small and defenceless if caught.
entries.v: 巴塔哥尼亚中新世一种体型小、身体轻盈的有蹄哺乳动物，长约70厘米，属于滑距骨目——一支与马无关的南美类群。它演化出了单趾的脚，退化程度甚至超过现代马，侧趾缩成了细小的骨片。它四肢细长，敏捷迅速，但体型小，一旦被抓住便毫无还手之力。

entries.k: A small, lightly built theropod about one metre long, much of it tail, from the Late Jurassic lagoons of Bavaria and southern France, about 150 million years old. For over a century it was the smallest dinosaur known. Its long hind legs made it a fast runner, and the first skeleton has a whole lizard, Bavarisaurus, preserved in its stomach. Close relatives had a coat of simple filament feathers.
entries.v: 一种体型小巧、骨架轻盈的兽脚类恐龙，体长约1米，其中大部分是尾巴，生活在约1.5亿年前巴伐利亚和法国南部的晚侏罗世潟湖地区。在一个多世纪里，它一直是已知最小的恐龙。修长的后腿使它善于快速奔跑，第一具骨架的胃里还保存着一整只蜥蜴——巴伐利亚蜥。它的近亲身上覆盖着简单的丝状羽毛。

entries.k: A small, lizard-like early reptile about 20 centimetres long from the Late Carboniferous of Ohio, about 307 million years ago. Its name means 'coal runner': it had long, slender legs and long toes ending in sharp, curved claws, and it is the oldest known reptile adapted for climbing. It darted over the ground and up tree trunks of the coal forest after insects, escaping danger with speed rather than strength.
entries.v: 一种体长约20厘米、形似蜥蜴的小型早期爬行动物，生活在约3.07亿年前美国俄亥俄州的晚石炭世。它的名字意为“煤炭奔跑者”：它有细长的腿和长长的脚趾，趾端是锋利弯曲的爪子，是已知最古老的适应攀爬的爬行动物。它在煤炭森林的地面上和树干上飞奔追捕昆虫，靠速度而非力量躲避危险。

entries.k: A small, lizard-like reptile about 25 centimetres long from the Early Permian of Texas and Oklahoma, around 285 million years ago. Its broad head held several rows of teeth for crushing insects and tough plant food. It is one of the earliest animals known to shed its tail when grabbed by a predator, along weak planes in the tail bones, and then regrow it. This trick let it survive attacks that would kill most small animals.
entries.v: 一种外形像蜥蜴的小型爬行动物，体长约 25 厘米，生活在约 2.85 亿年前二叠纪早期的美国得克萨斯和俄克拉何马。它宽阔的头部长有好几排牙齿，用来压碎昆虫和坚韧的植物。它是已知最早能在被掠食者抓住时沿尾椎上的薄弱面断尾、随后再生尾巴的动物之一。这一招让它能在足以杀死大多数小动物的攻击中幸存下来。

entries.k: A small, long-bodied tetrapod about 20 cm long from East Kirkton in Scotland, about 338 million years old, where it lived around a volcanic lake together with early scorpions and amphibians. Nicknamed 'Lizzie', it was first hailed as the oldest reptile, but it is now seen as a close relative of the amniotes rather than a true reptile. It had a long trunk, short little limbs and a long tail, and probably hunted small invertebrates among the plants.
entries.v: 一种身体细长的小型四足动物，体长约20厘米，出自苏格兰的东柯克顿，距今约3.38亿年，与早期的蝎子和两栖动物一起生活在火山湖畔。它绰号“丽兹”，最初被誉为最古老的爬行动物，但如今被视为羊膜动物的近亲，而非真正的爬行动物。它躯干修长，四肢短小，尾巴很长，可能在植物间捕食小型无脊椎动物。

entries.k: A small, millipede-like myriapod from the island of Kerrera in western Scotland, dated to about 425 million years ago, which makes it one of the oldest known land animals. Its slender body was made of simple, rounded segments, each bearing a pair of legs on each side. It lived around a lake among early plants and probably fed on decaying plant matter and microbial mats.
entries.v: 一种形似马陆的小型多足动物，出自苏格兰西部的克雷拉岛，年代约为4.25亿年前，是已知最古老的陆生动物之一。它细长的身体由简单的圆形体节组成，每节两侧各有一对足。它生活在湖泊周围的早期植物之间，可能以腐烂的植物和微生物席为食。

entries.k: A small, mole-like dicynodont about 30 centimetres long from the Late Permian of South Africa, Zambia and India, around 256 million years ago. Its flat, wedge-shaped head and short, massively built forelimbs with broad claws were made for digging, and it probably spent much of its life underground like a modern mole, feeding on roots and perhaps insects. Hidden in its burrows it was hard for predators to reach, but in the open it was slow and clumsy.
entries.v: 一种外形像鼹鼠的小型二齿兽，体长约 30 厘米，生活在约 2.56 亿年前二叠纪晚期的南非、赞比亚和印度。它扁平的楔形头部和短而极其粗壮、带宽爪的前肢都是为挖掘而生，它很可能像现代鼹鼠一样一生大部分时间待在地下，以植物根部或许还有昆虫为食。躲在洞穴里时掠食者很难够到它，但在地面上它行动迟缓笨拙。

entries.k: A small, plain brown ant from the Paraná River region of South America, now established in Mediterranean-climate regions on every inhabited continent. In its invaded range, nests that would normally fight one another treat each other as nestmates, forming supercolonies that can stretch for hundreds of kilometres. It feeds largely on the honeydew of sap-sucking insects and displaces many native ant species.
entries.v: 一种来自南美洲巴拉那河流域的朴素褐色小蚂蚁，如今已在所有有人居住大陆的地中海气候区定居。在入侵地区，原本会互相争斗的蚁巢彼此视为同巢伙伴，形成绵延数百公里的超级蚁群。它主要以吸汁昆虫分泌的蜜露为食，排挤了许多本土蚂蚁物种。

entries.k: A small, quick arthrodire placoderm about 25 centimetres long from a Late Devonian reef in Western Australia, about 380 million years ago. It had a streamlined armoured head and shoulder shield, large eyes and sharp, self-sharpening bony jaw blades, and darted about the reef snapping up small fish and shrimp-like prey. It is the official state fossil of Western Australia.
entries.v: 一种小巧敏捷的节甲鱼类盾皮鱼，体长约25厘米，来自约3.8亿年前西澳大利亚的晚泥盆世礁石。它有流线型的头肩甲、大眼睛和能自我磨利的锋利骨质颌刃，在礁石间快速穿梭，捕食小鱼和类似虾的猎物。它是西澳大利亚州的官方州化石。

entries.k: A small, round, umbrella-shaped Ediacaran organism, about 1 to 4 cm across, with eight arms spiralling out from a central knob. It is unusual in being found both in the Doushantuo Formation of South China and in the Ediacara Member of South Australia. The ridges crossing its arms recall the comb rows of comb jellies, its most likely relatives, and recent work suggests it lived on the seafloor rather than drifting.
entries.v: 一种小型、圆形、伞状的埃迪卡拉纪生物，直径约1至4厘米，八条臂从中央的突起呈螺旋状伸出。它的特别之处在于既见于华南的陡山沱组，也见于南澳大利亚的埃迪卡拉段。横贯其臂的脊让人联想到栉水母的栉板列，而栉水母正是它最可能的近亲；近期研究认为它生活在海底，而非随水漂浮。

entries.k: A small, slender conodont a few centimetres long; Panderodus was one of the longest-lived and most widespread conodonts. Its flattened, eel-like body carried a grasping apparatus of long, slender, fang-like cones, each with a deep groove along its side that may have carried venom, which would make it one of the oldest venomous animals known. Tiny and fragile but quick, it could subdue prey far tougher than itself.
entries.v: 一种体长只有几厘米的细长牙形动物；潘德尔刺是存续时间最长、分布最广的牙形动物之一。它扁平、像鳗鱼一样的身体前端长着一套抓握器，由细长的獠牙状锥形分子组成，每枚侧面都有一道深沟，可能用来输送毒液，这将使它成为已知最古老的有毒动物之一。它小巧脆弱却行动迅速，能制服比自己强壮得多的猎物。

entries.k: A small, slender relative of crocodiles about 1 metre long, most of it tail, from the Late Triassic of south Wales about 205 million years ago. Unlike its descendants it lived on land, with long, thin, upright legs that made it a fast runner, a small pointed head and a double row of small scutes down its back. It chased insects and lizards, relying on speed rather than strength.
entries.v: 一种小巧纤细的鳄类亲戚，体长约1米，大部分是尾巴，约2.05亿年前生活在晚三叠世的南威尔士。与后代不同，它生活在陆地上，细长直立的四肢使它善于快跑，头小而尖，背上有两列小鳞甲。它追捕昆虫和蜥蜴，靠的是速度而不是力量。

entries.k: A small, spectacularly spiny trilobite about 6 centimetres long from the Early Devonian seas of Morocco, about 400 million years ago. Two great curled horns like a ram's swept back from its head, and long paired spines bristled from its cheeks, every body segment and its tail. It was small and harmless, but its thicket of spines made it almost impossible to swallow.
entries.v: 一种小巧而多刺得惊人的三叶虫，体长约6厘米，来自约4亿年前摩洛哥的早泥盆世海洋。两只像公羊角一样卷曲的巨角从头部向后弯伸，颊部、每个体节和尾部都长着成对的长刺。它体小无害，但密密麻麻的棘刺让它几乎不可能被吞下。

entries.k: A small, thimble-shaped animal from the Ediacara Member of South Australia, about 555 million years old, up to about 2 cm across and 1.5 cm high. At least four long, straight, needle-like spicules, up to 37 cm long, radiated from its body down to the seafloor and probably propped it up. Described in 2012, it is one of the oldest animals known with hard skeletal parts, and may have been an early sponge.
entries.v: 一种小型顶针状动物，来自南澳大利亚的埃迪卡拉段，距今约5.55亿年，直径可达约2厘米，高约1.5厘米。至少四根细长、笔直的针状骨针从身体向下辐射至海底，长达37厘米，可能起到支撑身体的作用。它于2012年被描述，是已知最古老的具有硬质骨骼结构的动物之一，可能是一种早期海绵。

entries.k: A smaller Dimetrodon, perhaps under 2 metres long, from the Early Permian of Prince Edward Island, Canada, about 290 million years ago. A farmer dug up its upper jaw in 1845, and it was named Bathygnathus borealis, 'deep jaw of the north', in 1854, one of the first sail-backed synapsid fossils ever described. A 2015 study showed it belonged to Dimetrodon. Only the deep snout with its long fangs is known, so its sail is inferred from its relatives.
entries.v: 一种较小的异齿龙，体长可能不足2米，出自加拿大爱德华王子岛约2.9亿年前的早二叠世地层。1845年，一位农民挖出了它的上颌；1854年它被命名为 Bathygnathus borealis，意为“北方的深颌”，是最早被描述的背帆合弓纲动物化石之一。2015年的一项研究表明它属于异齿龙属。目前仅知其带有长獠牙的高吻部，因此它的背帆是根据近亲推断的。

entries.k: A smaller relative of Estemmenosuchus uralensis from the same Middle Permian beds near Ocher in the Perm region of Russia, about 267 million years ago. 'Mirabilis' means 'wonderful': it had two bony horns on each side of its head, one rising from the top of the skull like a short antler and one jutting sideways from the cheek. These were probably for display or contests between rivals. Like its relative it was a bulky plant-eater or omnivore with smooth, glandular skin.
entries.v: 乌拉尔冠鳄兽（Estemmenosuchus uralensis）的一种较小近亲，出自俄罗斯彼尔姆边疆区奥乔尔附近的同一套中二叠世地层，距今约2.67亿年。“mirabilis”意为“奇异的”：它头部两侧各有两只骨质角，一只从头骨顶部升起，像一截短鹿角，另一只从脸颊向侧面伸出。这些角可能用于炫耀或与对手较量。和近亲一样，它是一种体形笨重的植食性或杂食性动物，皮肤光滑、富含腺体。

entries.k: A smaller species of Arthropleura, the giant Carboniferous millipede relatives, reaching perhaps 30 to 50 centimetres. It is known mainly from fragments of its armour, whose tergites carried more prominent crested ridges than those of its giant cousin. Like other arthropleurids it probably browsed plant debris on the floors of the coal swamp forests.
entries.v: 节胸蜈蚣（石炭纪巨型千足虫近亲）中的一个较小物种，体长可能为30至50厘米。它主要通过甲壳碎片为人所知，其背板上的脊冠比它的巨型表亲更为突出。与其他节胸蜈蚣类一样，它可能在煤沼森林的地面上取食植物碎屑。

entries.k: A smooth, rounded trilobite a few centimetres long from the Late Ordovician of eastern North America. Its head and tail shields were very strongly arched and almost featureless, and its small eyes sat far back on the head. It probably spent most of its life sitting in a burrow with only the front of its head showing, feeding on particles in the water; tucked into the sediment it was very hard for predators to dig out.
entries.v: 一种光滑浑圆的三叶虫，体长几厘米，生活在北美东部的奥陶纪晚期。它的头甲和尾甲高高拱起，几乎没有任何纹饰，小小的眼睛位于头部后方。它大概一生中大部分时间都待在洞穴里，只露出头部前端，滤食水中的颗粒；藏进沉积物后，捕食者很难把它挖出来。

entries.k: A social amoeba of forest soil and leaf litter. Its cells live alone, eating bacteria, until food runs out; then tens of thousands stream together, called by pulses of a chemical signal, into a slug that crawls toward light and heat. The slug rises into a fruiting body: a fifth of the cells die to build a stalk, lifting the rest as a ball of spores to be carried away. Its cooperation, and its cheaters, make it a model of how multicellular life could arise.
entries.v: 一种生活在森林土壤和落叶层中的社会性变形虫。它的细胞平时独自生活，以细菌为食，直到食物耗尽；这时，数以万计的细胞在一阵阵化学信号脉冲的召唤下汇聚到一起，形成一条蛞蝓状的“虫体”，朝着光和热爬去。随后，这条“蛞蝓”会立起来变成子实体：五分之一的细胞牺牲自己筑成柄，把其余细胞托举成一团孢子，以便被带往远处。它的合作行为，以及其中的“作弊者”，使它成为研究多细胞生命如何起源的模式生物。

entries.k: A social bee living in colonies of tens of thousands of workers around a single queen. Workers gather nectar and pollen from flowers, store honey in wax combs, and use the waggle dance to tell nestmates where food is. As pollinators of crops and wild plants, they are among the most important insects to people.
entries.v: 一种社会性蜜蜂，数万只工蜂围绕一只蜂王组成蜂群。工蜂从花中采集花蜜和花粉，将蜂蜜储存在蜡质巢脾中，并用摇摆舞告诉同伴食物的位置。作为农作物和野生植物的传粉者，它们是对人类最重要的昆虫之一。

entries.k: A soil and pond amoeba that is not an amoebozoan at all but belongs to the excavates, far from the true amoebae: it crawls by bursting out one broad rounded pseudopod after another and eats bacteria. When its water changes it can grow two flagella and swim off within minutes, then turn back into an amoeba, or wall itself up in a cyst to wait out drying. It shows how often the amoeboid way of life evolved in different branches of the eukaryotes.
entries.v: 一种生活在土壤和池塘中的变形虫，但它根本不属于变形虫门，而是属于古虫类，与真正的变形虫亲缘关系很远：它通过一个接一个地猛然鼓出宽大圆钝的伪足来爬行，以细菌为食。当周围的水环境发生变化时，它能在几分钟内长出两根鞭毛游走，之后再变回变形虫；它也可以把自己封闭在包囊中，熬过干旱。它说明了变形虫式的生活方式曾在真核生物的不同分支中多次演化出来。

entries.k: A solitary horn coral a few centimetres tall from mid-Silurian reefs of Gotland and England, shaped like an upside-down, four-sided pyramid. Its polyp could close itself in completely with four triangular lid plates that fitted over the square cup like a trapdoor. Fixed in place and catching small prey with its tentacles, it was almost impossible to harm once shut.
entries.v: 一种几厘米高的单体四射珊瑚，生活于瑞典哥得兰岛和英国志留纪中期的礁中，形状像一个倒置的四棱锥。它的珊瑚虫可以用四块三角形的盖板把自己完全封闭起来，盖板像活板门一样盖住方形的萼。它固着不动，用触手捕捉小猎物，一旦关闭就几乎无法被伤害。

entries.k: A solitary horn coral from Late Ordovician limestones of New York, and one of the early rugose corals. Each polyp lived alone in a curved, cone-shaped skeleton a few centimetres long and about 1.5-2 cm wide at the top, whose deep cup was lined with alternating long and short ridges called septa. It had no holdfast and probably lay on the soft sea floor with its tip in the mud, catching small prey with its tentacles.
entries.v: 一种单体角珊瑚，产自美国纽约州晚奥陶世石灰岩，是较早的四射珊瑚之一。每个水螅体独自生活在弯曲的圆锥形骨骼中，骨骼长数厘米，顶端宽约1.5–2厘米，深深的萼部内排列着长短交替的放射状隔壁。它没有固着结构，可能以尖端插入泥中斜躺在松软的海底，用触手捕捉小型猎物。

entries.k: A solitary sea anemone of rocky tide pools along the coast of California and Baja California, named for the pink-lavender rays on its green oral disc. Its stinging tentacles catch small crustaceans, fish and drifting animals, while symbiotic algae in its tissues add food from sunlight and give it its green colour. Long confused with the cloning aggregating anemone, it was only described as a separate species in 2000.
entries.v: 一种独居海葵，生活在加利福尼亚和下加利福尼亚沿岸的岩石潮池中，因绿色口盘上粉紫色的放射纹而得名。它带刺细胞的触手捕捉小型甲壳动物、鱼类和漂流动物，组织中的共生藻则利用阳光为它补充养分，并赋予它绿色。它长期与能克隆繁殖的群聚海葵混淆，直到2000年才被描述为独立物种。

entries.k: A sparrow-sized bird of Eurasian rivers and lakes that watches from a low perch, then plunges headfirst into the water after small fish. Its brilliant blue is structural colour, made by light scattering in the feathers rather than by pigment.
entries.v: 一种麻雀大小的鸟，生活在欧亚大陆的河流和湖泊边，停在低处的栖枝上观察，然后头朝下扎入水中捕捉小鱼。它亮丽的蓝色是结构色，由羽毛中的光散射形成，而非来自色素。

entries.k: A spindle-shaped green flagellate of ponds and puddles that swims with one long whip and steers toward light with a red eyespot. It has chloroplasts, captured long ago from a green alga, and makes its food by photosynthesis, but in the dark it lives on dissolved food like an animal, which is why it was claimed both by botanists and zoologists. Its flexible skin of spiral protein strips lets it squirm and change shape.
entries.v: 一种生活在池塘和水洼中的纺锤形绿色鞭毛虫，靠一根长鞭毛游动，并借助红色的眼点朝光源前进。它含有叶绿体——那是很久以前从一种绿藻那里“俘获”来的——能通过光合作用自己制造养料；但在黑暗中，它会像动物一样靠溶解的养分生活，因此植物学家和动物学家都曾把它归为自己的研究对象。它柔韧的表膜由螺旋排列的蛋白质条带构成，使它能够扭动身体、改变形状。

entries.k: A spindle-shaped rangeomorph that lay flat on the deep seafloor at Mistaken Point, Newfoundland, about 565 million years ago. Its two rows of frondlets branched again and again into smaller copies of themselves. Maps of whole bedding surfaces show that it spread in clusters, probably both by runner-like stolons and by drifting propagules, making it one of the earliest records of how a population of large organisms grew. It is named after S. B. Misra, who found the Mistaken Point fossils in 1967.
entries.v: 一种纺锤形的蕨叶虫类生物，约5.65亿年前平躺在纽芬兰误认角的深海海底。它的两列小叶一再分枝，形成越来越小的自身复制品。整个层面的分布图显示它成簇扩散，可能既靠类似匍匐茎的匍匐枝繁殖，也靠漂流的繁殖体传播，因而是关于大型生物种群如何增长的最早记录之一。其种名纪念S. B. 米斯拉，他于1967年发现了误认角的化石。

entries.k: A spinosaurid about 9 metres long that hunted along rivers and lagoons in England and Spain about 125 million years ago. It had a long, narrow, crocodile-like snout with almost 100 teeth and a huge 30 cm thumb claw, used like a gaff to hook fish. Scales of a large fish and the bones of a young Iguanodon were found in its stomach, so it hunted both in the water and on land.
entries.v: 一种体长约9米的棘龙类，约1.25亿年前在英格兰和西班牙的河流与潟湖边捕猎。它长着狭长、像鳄鱼一样的吻部，有近100颗牙齿，拇指上还有一个长达30厘米的巨爪，可以像鱼钩一样把鱼钩出水面。它的胃里发现了大鱼的鳞片和一只幼年禽龙的骨头，说明它在水中和陆地上都会捕猎。

entries.k: A spiny cheirurid trilobite from the Middle to Late Ordovician of New York and Ontario, usually a few centimetres long. It had a bulbous, furrowed glabella, long backward-curving cheek spines, short spiny segment tips and two long spines on its small tail. Specimens from the Walcott-Rust Quarry in New York preserve its legs and gills, showing how trilobite limbs were built. It probably hunted or scavenged small animals on the sea floor.
entries.v: 一种多刺的镜眼虫类三叶虫，来自纽约州和安大略省的中至晚奥陶世，通常长几厘米。它有一个膨大、带沟的头鞍，长长的向后弯曲的颊刺，短而多刺的体节末端，小小的尾部上还有两根长刺。纽约州沃尔科特-拉斯特采石场的标本保存了它的足和鳃，展示了三叶虫附肢的构造。它可能在海底捕食或取食小动物的尸体。

entries.k: A spiny grazer of the kelp forests of North America's Pacific coast that scrapes algae with a five-toothed jaw. Where sea otters, its main predator, disappear, urchin swarms can mow kelp forests down to bare 'urchin barrens'.
entries.v: 一种生活在北美太平洋沿岸海藻林中的多刺食草动物，用五齿颚刮食藻类。在其主要天敌海獭消失的地方，成群的海胆能将海藻林啃成光秃秃的“海胆荒漠”。

entries.k: A spiny trilobite from the Early Devonian of Morocco, about 400 million years ago, famous for the long three-pronged 'trident' sticking out from the front of its head. Besides the trident it carried long cheek spines, a spine on every body segment and spikes above its large eyes. The trident may have been used by males in contests, like the horns of a stag beetle.
entries.v: 一种来自摩洛哥早泥盆世的多刺三叶虫，距今约4亿年，以从头部前方伸出的长长的三叉“戟”而闻名。除了三叉戟，它还长着长长的颊刺、每个体节上的一根棘刺，以及大眼睛上方的尖刺。这把三叉戟可能被雄性用于争斗，就像锹甲的角一样。

entries.k: A spiny trilobite up to about 9 cm long from the Burgess Shale, famous because some fossils keep its legs, antennae and a pair of antenna-like cerci at the tail. Its legs had spiny bases for tearing apart food, so it was probably a predator and scavenger on the seafloor. Some specimens show healed injuries, evidence that it survived attacks by predators.
entries.v: 一种多刺的三叶虫，体长可达约9厘米，产自布尔吉斯页岩。它之所以出名，是因为部分化石保存了它的足、触角以及尾部一对似触角的尾须。它的足基部长有棘刺，可用来撕碎食物，因此它很可能是海底的掠食者兼食腐者。一些标本带有愈合的伤痕，证明它曾在掠食者的攻击中幸存。

entries.k: A spiny, soft-legged animal about 8.5 cm long from the Xiaoshiba biota of Yunnan, China, nicknamed "the hairy Collins' monster". Its back carried 72 sharp spines, up to five per body segment, while six pairs of feathery front legs combed food from the water and nine pairs of clawed hind legs held it in place. Bristling with spines, it is almost impossible to attack safely, but it is slow and weak in a fight.
entries.v: 一种多刺、长着柔软足的动物，体长约 8.5 厘米，来自中国云南的小石坝生物群，绰号“毛茸茸的柯林斯怪物”。它的背上长着 72 根尖刺，每个体节最多五根；六对羽毛状的前足从水中梳取食物，九对带爪的后足把身体固定住。它浑身是刺，几乎无法被安全地攻击，但行动缓慢，战斗力弱。

entries.k: A spiriferid brachiopod from the Middle Devonian, about 385 million years ago, very common in the Hamilton Group shales of New York and Ontario. Its ribbed calcite shell is much wider than long, a few centimetres across, with the straight hinge line drawn out into long pointed wings, a raised fold down one valve and a matching groove in the other. It lay on the muddy sea floor, and inside the shell a pair of coiled calcite spirals supported its feeding tentacles.
entries.v: 一种中泥盆世（约3.85亿年前）的石燕类腕足动物，在纽约州和安大略省的汉密尔顿群页岩中极为常见。它带肋纹的方解石壳宽远大于长，宽数厘米，笔直的铰合线向两侧延伸成细长的尖翼，一片壳瓣上有隆起的中隆，另一片则有与之对应的中槽。它平躺在泥质海底，壳内一对盘旋的方解石腕螺支撑着取食用的触手。

entries.k: A springtail from the Early Devonian Rhynie chert of Scotland, about 410 million years ago, and one of the oldest six-legged animals known. Only 1 to 2 millimetres long, it had short antennae, three pairs of legs and a forked jumping organ folded under its abdomen that could fling it into the air. It lived in the damp plant litter around hot springs, feeding on fungi, algae and decaying plants.
entries.v: 一种跳虫，产自约4.1亿年前苏格兰早泥盆世的莱尼燧石层，是已知最古老的六足动物之一。它体长仅1至2毫米，有短触角、三对足，以及折叠在腹部下方的叉状弹跳器，可以将身体弹向空中。它生活在温泉周围潮湿的植物碎屑中，以真菌、藻类和腐烂的植物为食。

entries.k: A square-bodied polyp a few centimetres across, held up on a short stalk from a disc in the mud, with four corner arms that split into bunches of tentacles. About 560 million years old, it shows the oldest known muscle tissue, bundles of fibres running through its body, and looks much like a living stalked jellyfish. Those muscles let it fold its arms quickly round prey and pull back from attackers.
entries.v: 一种方形身体的水螅体，宽几厘米，靠一根短柄立在泥中的圆盘上，四角各伸出一条臂，分叉成一簇簇触手。它约有 5.6 亿年历史，保存着已知最古老的肌肉组织，即贯穿全身的纤维束，外形很像现生的有柄水母。这些肌肉让它能迅速收拢触臂裹住猎物，并在遭到攻击时缩回。

entries.k: A squid-like belemnite that hunted with ten hooked arms in the shallow Sundance Sea of Wyoming about 160 million years ago. Its internal guard was the chunkiest of any belemnite, about 10 cm long but 6 cm wide, and it belonged to the megateuthidids, a family thought to have mostly died out millions of years earlier.
entries.v: 一种形似鱿鱼的箭石，约1.6亿年前在怀俄明州浅浅的森丹斯海中用十条带钩的腕捕猎。它的内部鞘是所有箭石中最粗壮的，长约10厘米、宽达6厘米。它属于巨箭石科，这个科被认为在数百万年前就已大多灭绝。

entries.k: A squirrel-like relative of the primates from the late Paleocene of Europe, about 60 cm long with a long bushy tail. It had claws instead of nails, eyes on the sides of its head and big gnawing front teeth like a rodent's. It climbed trees and fed on leaves, seeds and fruit.
entries.v: 一种来自欧洲晚古新世、形似松鼠的灵长类亲戚，体长约60厘米，有一条蓬松的长尾。它长着爪而不是指甲，眼睛位于头部两侧，还有像啮齿动物那样用来啃咬的大门齿。它在树上攀爬，以树叶、种子和果实为食。

entries.k: A stalked, branching polyp about 20 cm tall whose two cups each held a crown of stinging tentacles, its name meaning "Attenborough's dawn lantern". Living about 560 million years ago in a deep sea otherwise full of passive fronds, it is one of the oldest known predatory animals, an early relative of jellyfish that snared passing prey. Its stinging cells make it the deadliest attacker of its world, but its thin skeleton and soft polyps break easily.
entries.v: 一种有柄、分叉的水螅体，高约 20 厘米，两个杯状体各托着一圈带刺细胞的触手，学名意为“爱登堡的黎明灯笼”。它生活在约 5.6 亿年前的深海中，那里几乎只有被动滤食的叶状生物；它是已知最古老的捕食性动物之一，是水母的早期亲戚，会捕捉游过的猎物。刺细胞让它成为那个世界最致命的攻击者，但它纤薄的骨架和柔软的水螅体很容易折断。

entries.k: A stegosaur about 4.5 metres long from the Late Jurassic Tendaguru beds of Tanzania, about 152 million years old. Pairs of narrow plates on its neck and shoulders gave way to pairs of long, sharp spikes along its hips and tail, and a long spike jutted back from each shoulder. Studies of its tail suggest it could swing the spikes fast enough to inflict deep wounds. Over a thousand of its bones were found, though many were destroyed in Berlin during the Second World War.
entries.v: 一种体长约4.5米的剑龙类，出自坦桑尼亚晚侏罗世的坦达古鲁层，距今约1.52亿年。它颈部和肩部成对的窄骨板，到臀部和尾部变为成对的尖长骨刺，每侧肩部还向后伸出一根长刺。对其尾部的研究表明，它甩动尾刺的速度足以造成深深的伤口。它的骨骼化石被发现了一千多块，但其中许多在第二次世界大战期间毁于柏林。

entries.k: A stethacanthid shark about 65 cm long from Bearsden near Glasgow in Scotland, about 330 million years old, known from exceptionally complete fossils. Its strangest feature was a tall dorsal spine topped by a flat, anvil-shaped 'brush' whose upper surface, like the top of its head, was covered with enlarged tooth-like denticles. The brush may have been a display structure or helped to make the shark look too big to swallow; it hunted fish and squid-like animals in shallow seas.
entries.v: 一种体长约65厘米的胸脊鲨类，来自苏格兰格拉斯哥附近的比尔斯登，距今约3.3亿年，以异常完整的化石而闻名。它最奇特的特征是一根高高的背棘，顶端长着一个扁平的砧状“刷子”，刷子上表面和头顶一样覆盖着增大的齿状小鳞。这个刷子可能用于展示，或者让鲨鱼看起来大得难以吞下；它在浅海中捕食鱼类和类似乌贼的动物。

entries.k: A stiff, flexible rod along the back: the first chordate skeleton.
entries.v: 沿背部延伸、坚韧而有弹性的杆：最早的脊索动物骨骼。

entries.k: A stocky marine reptile about 2 metres long from the Middle Triassic seas of Germany, about 243 million years ago. It plucked shellfish from the sea floor with its forward-pointing front teeth and crushed them with broad, flat tooth plates on its jaws and palate. Its heavy, dense bones acted as ballast, and a row of bony knobs ran down its back. It swam slowly with its long tail and short, paddle-like limbs.
entries.v: 一种体格粗壮的海生爬行动物，长约2米，来自德国中三叠世的海洋，距今约2.43亿年。它用向前突出的前齿从海底拔取贝类，再用颌部和上颚上宽而平的齿板把它们压碎。它沉重而致密的骨骼起到压舱物的作用，背上还有一排骨质瘤突。它靠长尾和短小的桨状四肢缓慢游动。

entries.k: A stocky, barrel-bodied rhynchosaur about 1.3 metres long from the Late Triassic Lossiemouth Sandstone near Elgin in Scotland, about 230 million years ago. Its broad, triangular skull ended in a hooked beak, and rows of teeth on its upper jaw fitted into a groove in the lower jaw to slice tough seed-ferns like secateurs. Rhynchosaurs of its genus were so abundant worldwide, from Brazil and Argentina to India, that they make up most of the fossils in some rock layers, and they are used to match Late Triassic rocks across continents.
entries.v: 一种身体粗壮、呈桶状的喙头龙类，体长约1.3米，来自苏格兰埃尔金附近晚三叠世的洛西茅斯砂岩，距今约2.3亿年。它宽阔的三角形头骨末端是一个钩状的喙，上颌的几排牙齿嵌入下颌的沟槽中，像修枝剪一样切割坚韧的种子蕨。该属的喙头龙类在世界各地极为繁盛，从巴西、阿根廷到印度都有分布，在某些岩层中构成了大部分化石，因此被用来对比各大陆的晚三叠世岩层。

entries.k: A stocky, black-and-silver member of the weasel family from Africa, the Middle East and India, about 75 cm long and famous for its fearlessness. Its thick, rubbery, loose skin resists bee stings, porcupine quills and teeth and lets it twist round to bite an attacker that has grabbed it, and it is partly resistant to snake venom. It digs out rodents, raids beehives, kills cobras and will stand up to lions and leopards.
entries.v: 一种体格敦实、黑银两色的鼬科动物，分布于非洲、中东和印度，体长约75厘米，以无所畏惧著称。它厚实、有弹性又松弛的皮肤能抵御蜂蜇、豪猪刺和利齿，被咬住时还能扭身反咬，并且对蛇毒有一定抵抗力。它挖掘捕食啮齿动物、袭击蜂巢、捕杀眼镜蛇，还敢与狮子和豹对峙。

entries.k: A stocky, land-living amphibian about 40 centimetres long from the Early Permian of Texas and Oklahoma, around 280 million years ago. It had a large, broad head with big eyes and a large ear notch, and a double row of interlocking bony plates ran down its back like a shield. Better armoured than almost any other amphibian of its size, it hunted insects and small animals on land and was tough for predators to crack.
entries.v: 一种体格粗壮的陆生两栖动物，体长约 40 厘米，生活在约 2.8 亿年前二叠纪早期的美国得克萨斯和俄克拉何马。它的头又大又宽，眼睛很大，耳缺也很大，背上有两列相互咬合的骨板，像盾牌一样沿脊背排列。它的防护几乎胜过所有同等体型的两栖动物，在陆地上捕食昆虫和小动物，掠食者很难对付它。

entries.k: A stocky, pig-sized dicynodont that cropped plants with a horny beak and had only two teeth, a pair of tusks in the upper jaw. Its genus was one of the few large land animals to survive the end-Permian mass extinction 252 million years ago and went on to dominate Early Triassic land faunas, making up most of the vertebrate fossils in some rock layers. Its fossils in South Africa, India and Antarctica helped support the idea of continental drift.
entries.v: 一种体格粗壮、猪一般大小的二齿兽，用角质喙啃食植物，只有两颗牙齿——上颌的一对獠牙。它所在的属是少数熬过2.52亿年前二叠纪末大灭绝的大型陆生动物之一，随后主宰了早三叠世的陆地动物群，在某些岩层中占脊椎动物化石的大多数。它在南非、印度和南极洲的化石为大陆漂移学说提供了支持。

entries.k: A stout fusulinid from Early Permian limestones of the Glass Mountains of West Texas, about 285 million years old, described in 1937. Its name means 'thick roof', for the heavy wall of its chambered calcite test, which is robust and swollen, under a centimetre long. A single cell lived inside, reaching out through the wall with thread-like pseudopods; vast numbers of such tests built up limestone on warm Permian shelves.
entries.v: 一种粗壮的蜓类，出自得克萨斯州西部格拉斯山脉约2.85亿年前的早二叠世石灰岩，1937年被描述。它的名字意为“厚顶”，指其分有房室的方解石壳的厚重壳壁；壳体粗壮膨胀，长不足1厘米。壳内生活着一个单细胞，通过丝状伪足穿过壳壁向外伸展；无数这样的壳在温暖的二叠纪陆架上堆积成了石灰岩。

entries.k: A straight-shelled heteromorph ammonite from the inland sea of North America, about 73 million years ago. After a tiny initial coil only millimetres across, its shell grew as a long, slightly flattened rod, often more than half a metre long, with crescent-shaped ribs and frilly sutures between the gas-filled chambers. Jaws found inside the shells suggest it fed on plankton. Its fossils are so abundant in the Pierre Shale that successive Baculites species are used to date the rocks.
entries.v: 一种来自北美内陆海的直壳异形菊石，距今约7300万年。它的壳在最初只有几毫米宽的微小盘旋之后，长成一根细长、略扁的杆，长度常超过半米，壳上有新月形的肋，充气腔室之间有褶边状的缝合线。壳内发现的颚表明它以浮游生物为食。它的化石在皮尔页岩中极为丰富，人们利用相继出现的杆菊石种来确定岩层的年代。

entries.k: A straight-shelled nautiloid from mid-Silurian seas of Europe and North America, with a long, slowly tapering shell ringed along its whole length by strong, rounded ridges. Gas-filled chambers kept it afloat while it hunted with a ring of grasping arms and a sharp beak. Its strong, ridged shell protected it from most attackers, and it could jet backwards to escape.
entries.v: 一种直壳鹦鹉螺类，生活于志留纪中期的欧洲和北美海洋，长长的外壳缓慢变细，全长环绕着粗壮圆润的环脊。充满气体的气室让它浮在水中，它用一圈抓握的腕和锋利的喙捕猎。坚固的环脊外壳使它免受大多数攻击者伤害，它还能向后喷水逃走。

entries.k: A strange marine reptile about 3 metres long from the Middle Triassic of Luoping in Yunnan, China, about 245 million years ago, and one of the earliest known plant-eating marine reptiles. Its jaws widened at the front into a hammerhead shape lined with chisel-like teeth, used to scrape algae off rocks, with many tiny needle-like teeth behind to filter it from the water. It was first described in 2014 with a zip-like split snout; better skulls found later revealed the hammerhead.
entries.v: 一种奇特的海生爬行动物，体长约3米，出自中国云南罗平的中三叠世地层，距今约2.45亿年，是已知最早的植食性海生爬行动物之一。它的颌部前端扩展成锤头状，排列着凿子般的牙齿，用来从岩石上刮下藻类；后面还有许多细小的针状牙齿，用来把藻类从水中滤出。它于2014年首次被描述时被认为具有拉链状开裂的吻部；后来发现的更完整头骨揭示了它的锤头形状。

entries.k: A strange relative of horses and rhinos from the Middle Miocene of Europe, about 2.6 m tall at the shoulder. Its long forelimbs and short hind legs gave it a gorilla-like sloping back, and it walked on its knuckles to keep its long hooked claws sharp. It probably sat or stood up on its hind legs to pull down branches with its claws.
entries.v: 一种来自欧洲中中新世、与马和犀牛有亲缘关系的奇特动物，肩高约2.6米。它前肢长、后肢短，背部像大猩猩一样向后倾斜；它用指关节行走，以保持长长的钩爪锋利。它可能坐着或用后肢站立，用爪子把树枝拉下来。

entries.k: A strange tree-climbing reptile about 50 centimetres long from the Late Triassic of Italy and New Mexico, about 210 million years ago. It had a bird-like head on a long neck, a humped back and an enormous claw on the second finger of each hand, probably used to tear open bark and rotten wood for insects. Its long tail ended in a bony hook that helped it grip branches.
entries.v: 一种奇特的树栖爬行动物，体长约50厘米，生活在约2.1亿年前晚三叠世的意大利和美国新墨西哥州。它长脖子上顶着像鸟一样的头，背部隆起，每只手的第二指上都长着一枚巨大的爪，大概用来撕开树皮和朽木寻找昆虫。它的长尾末端有一个骨质钩爪，帮助它抓牢树枝。

entries.k: A strange trilobite about 3 cm long from the mid-Silurian of Bohemia and Britain. Its head was little more than a huge, balloon-like glabella with long, outward-curving cheek spines, and its narrow body bore long, free spines along each side and a pair of long tail spines.
